rules.rule_name: Account Filter Non-Numeric Validation Error
rules.rule_description: When a user enters a non-numeric value in the Account ID filter field, the system must reject the input, set a specific error message, and prevent any row selections from being made.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: Account filter must be an 11-digit numeric number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card List screen and has entered a value in the Account ID filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered Account ID filter value is not blank, not zero, and is NOT a numeric value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the input state to ERROR, (2) Mark the Account Filter as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK), (3) Set the error message to 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER', (4) Set the Account ID in the session to zero, (5) Protect all 7 card selection rows from user input so no row action can be selected

rules.rule_name: Account Filter Blank or Zero Treated as No Filter
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID filter field is left blank or contains zero, the system treats it as no filter being applied and allows processing to continue without error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: Account filter must be an 11-digit numeric number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID filter field is blank, contains only spaces, contains only low-values, or its numeric equivalent equals zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Mark the Account Filter as blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK), (2) Set the session Account ID to zero, (3) Apply no account-based filtering to the card list, (4) Continue processing without setting any error condition

rules.rule_name: Card Number Filter Non-Numeric Validation Error
rules.rule_description: When a user enters a non-numeric value in the Card Number filter field, the system must reject the input, set a specific error message, and prevent any row selections from being made.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: Card ID filter must be a 16-digit numeric number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card List screen and has entered a value in the Card Number filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered Card Number filter value is not blank, not zero, and is NOT a numeric value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the input state to ERROR, (2) Mark the Card Filter as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), (3) Set the error message to 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' only if no prior error message has already been set, (4) Set the session Card Number to zero, (5) Protect all 7 card selection rows from user input so no row action can be selected

rules.rule_name: Card Number Filter Blank or Zero Treated as No Filter
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number filter field is left blank or contains zero, the system treats it as no filter being applied and allows processing to continue without error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: Card ID filter must be a 16-digit numeric number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number filter field is blank, contains only spaces, contains only low-values, or its numeric equivalent equals zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Mark the Card Filter as blank (FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK), (2) Set the session Card Number to zero, (3) Apply no card-number-based filtering to the card list, (4) Continue processing without setting any error condition

rules.rule_name: Multiple Row Selections Not Allowed
rules.rule_description: When a user enters action codes in more than one row simultaneously, the system must reject the submission, mark all rows that had selections as errors, and display an appropriate error message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: Only one row can be selected at a time / Mark all selected rows with error indicator

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card List screen and has entered action codes (S for View or U for Update) in the selection fields of the displayed card rows
acceptance_criteria.When: The total count of rows containing 'S' (View) or 'U' (Update) across all 7 selection fields is greater than 1
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the input state to ERROR, (2) Set the WS-MORE-THAN-1-ACTION flag to TRUE, (3) Copy the selection flags to an error flags array, (4) In the error flags array, replace every 'S' and every 'U' with '1' and all other characters with '0' to mark exactly which rows had selections, (5) Keep all 7 card selection rows accessible (not protected) so the user can correct the selection

rules.rule_name: Invalid Action Code in Row Selection Field
rules.rule_description: When a user enters a value other than 'S', 'U', or blank in a row selection field, the system must mark that specific row as having an error and set an invalid action code error message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: Invalid action code / Mark offending row with error indicator

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card List screen and has entered a value in one or more of the 7 row selection fields
acceptance_criteria.When: A row selection field contains a value that is not 'S' (View), not 'U' (Update), and not blank or space
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the input state to ERROR, (2) Set the error indicator '1' for that specific row in the row error flags array, (3) Set the error message to indicate an invalid action code only if no prior error message has already been set (WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF is true), (4) Keep all 7 card selection rows accessible (not protected) so the user can correct the entry

rules.rule_name: Protect All Selection Rows When Filter Validation Fails
rules.rule_description: When either the Account ID filter or the Card Number filter fails validation, all 7 row selection fields on the screen must be protected (made non-enterable) to prevent the user from attempting row actions while filter errors exist.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Protect all 7 card selection rows from input

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the Credit Card List screen with filter values entered
acceptance_criteria.When: Either the Account ID filter is marked as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK) OR the Card Number filter is marked as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set all 7 row selection fields (CRDSEL1 through CRDSEL7) to protected/non-enterable attribute (DFHBMPRF for row 1, DFHBMPRO for rows 2-7) so the user cannot enter any action code until the filter errors are corrected

rules.rule_name: Conditional Forward Record Read When Input Error Exists but Filters Are Valid
rules.rule_description: When an input error exists (such as an invalid row selection) but both the Account ID filter and Card Number filter are individually valid, the system still performs a forward read of card records to populate the list for display context before showing the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Are BOTH Account Filter AND Card Filter valid? No filter errors present

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has detected an input error condition on the Credit Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The input error exists AND the Account ID filter is NOT marked as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is false) AND the Card Number filter is NOT marked as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is false)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must perform a forward read of credit card records (9000-READ-FORWARD) starting from the current card position bookmark, applying any active account or card number filters, to populate up to 7 card rows for display alongside the error message

rules.rule_name: Skip Record Read When Filter Errors Exist
rules.rule_description: When an input error exists and at least one filter field (Account ID or Card Number) is invalid, the system skips the forward record read entirely and proceeds directly to re-displaying the screen with error indicators.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No - Filter errors exist / Skip record read

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has detected an input error condition on the Credit Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID filter is marked as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is true) OR the Card Number filter is marked as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must skip the forward read of card records entirely and proceed directly to setting up the error message display and re-rendering the screen without attempting to read any card data

rules.rule_name: Error Message Propagation to Screen Display
rules.rule_description: When an input error condition exists, the system must transfer the error message text to the screen output area and set up the next program navigation context to remain on the Card List screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Up Error Message on Screen Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: An input error has been detected and the system is preparing to re-display the Credit Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The input error flag is set to TRUE
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Move the error message text (WS-ERROR-MSG) to the screen error message output field (ERRMSGO), (2) Set the current program as both the source program and the next program to navigate to, (3) Set the current map and mapset as both the last used and the next to display, ensuring the user remains on the Card List screen after the error is shown

rules.rule_name: Highlight Invalid Account Filter Field in Red
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID filter field contains an invalid value, the system must visually highlight it in red on the screen and position the cursor to it so the user can immediately identify and correct the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Highlight invalid fields in Red on screen / Protect rows if filter errors

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to re-display the Credit Card List screen after an input error
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID filter is marked as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the Account ID filter field color attribute to RED (DFHRED), (2) Set the cursor length indicator for the Account ID field to -1 to position the cursor at that field on the screen

rules.rule_name: Highlight Invalid Card Number Filter Field in Red
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number filter field contains an invalid value, the system must visually highlight it in red on the screen and position the cursor to it so the user can immediately identify and correct the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Highlight invalid fields in Red on screen / Protect rows if filter errors

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to re-display the Credit Card List screen after an input error
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number filter is marked as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the Card Number filter field color attribute to RED (DFHRED), (2) Set the cursor length indicator for the Card Number field to -1 to position the cursor at that field on the screen

rules.rule_name: Highlight Invalid Row Selection Fields in Red
rules.rule_description: When a row selection field contains an invalid action code or is part of a multiple-selection error, the system must visually highlight that specific row's selection field in red and position the cursor to it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Highlight invalid fields in Red on screen / Protect rows if filter errors

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to re-display the Credit Card List screen after a row selection validation error
acceptance_criteria.When: A row's error indicator flag (WS-ROW-CRDSELECT-ERROR) is set to '1' for any of the 7 card rows
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must for each affected row: (1) Set that row's selection field color attribute to RED (DFHRED), (2) Set the cursor length indicator for that row's selection field to -1 to position the cursor there. Additionally, for row 1 specifically: if the selection field is blank or low-values, display an asterisk '*' in the field to visually indicate the error position

rules.rule_name: Cursor Positioning to First Error Field When Input is Valid
rules.rule_description: When no filter validation errors exist and the input is considered valid, the system positions the cursor at the Account ID filter field as the default starting position for the next user interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Position cursor at first field with error

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to display the Credit Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The overall input state is valid (INPUT-OK is true), meaning no account filter errors and no card filter errors are present
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set the cursor length indicator for the Account ID filter field (ACCTSIDL) to -1 to position the cursor at the Account ID field, ready for the user's next input

rules.rule_name: Re-display Card List Screen with Error Indicators
rules.rule_description: After setting up all error messages and field highlights, the system sends the complete Credit Card List screen back to the user with all error indicators visible, then returns control awaiting the user's corrective input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Re-display Credit Card List Screen with Error Indicators

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed setting up error messages, field highlights, and cursor positioning for the Credit Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: An input error condition exists and the screen preparation steps (screen init, array population, attribute setup, message setup) have all been completed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Send the fully prepared Credit Card List screen (map CCRDLIAO within mapset LIT-THISMAPSET) to the user's terminal with ERASE to clear the previous screen and FREEKB to release the keyboard, (2) Save the current session state including program name, transaction ID, map name, and mapset name to the communication area, (3) Return control to CICS specifying the same transaction ID so the system awaits the user's next corrective input

rules.rule_name: First Error Message Priority Rule
rules.rule_description: When multiple validation errors could potentially set error messages, only the first error message encountered is retained. Subsequent error conditions do not overwrite an already-set error message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: Invalid action code / Mark offending row with error indicator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is validating inputs on the Credit Card List screen and an error message has already been set by a prior validation check
acceptance_criteria.When: A subsequent validation check (such as card filter error or invalid row action code) also detects an error condition
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must NOT overwrite the existing error message. The new error message is only set if the error message flag (WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF) indicates that no prior error message has been set. This ensures the first detected error message is the one displayed to the user.

key_functionalities.title: Page Up at First Page
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF7 Page Up])
    B{Is This Already\nthe First Page?}
    C[Retrieve First Card Key\nfrom Current Session State]
    D[Read Forward from\nFirst Card Key\nUp to 7 Credit Card Records]
    E[Apply Account ID Filter\nif Account Filter is Active]
    F[Apply Card Number Filter\nif Card Number Filter is Active]
    G[Collect Matching Records:\nAccount Number, Card Number,\nCard Active Status]
    H[Set Message:\n'NO PREVIOUS PAGES\nTO DISPLAY']
    I[Populate Screen with\nSame First Page Results]
    J([Display First Page\nwith Advisory Message])
    K([Continue to Other\nPF7 Navigation Logic])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Already on First Page| C
    B -->|No - Not on First Page| K
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G --> H
    H --> I
    I --> J

rules.rule_name: Detect Page Up Request on First Page
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7 (Page Up) and the current page is already the first page of card results, the system identifies this condition and routes to the first-page re-display logic instead of attempting backward navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is This Already the First Page?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen and the current page is flagged as the First Page (CA-FIRST-PAGE is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 (Page Up)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system recognises that no previous page exists and proceeds to re-read and redisplay the same first page of card records, rather than attempting to navigate backward

rules.rule_name: Retrieve First Card Key for Re-display
rules.rule_description: When re-displaying the first page after a PF7 press on the first page, the system retrieves the saved first card number bookmark from the current session state to use as the starting point for the forward read.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve First Card Key from Current Session State

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 while already on the first page of card results, and the session state holds a saved First Card Number (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM) representing the first card displayed on the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to re-read the first page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the card file read position to the saved First Card Number (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM), so that the forward read begins from the same starting card as the currently displayed first page

rules.rule_name: Read Forward Up to 7 Card Records from First Card Key
rules.rule_description: Starting from the first card key bookmark, the system reads forward through the card file and collects up to a maximum of 7 credit card records to populate the display page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Forward from First Card Key Up to 7 Credit Card Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card file read position has been set to the First Card Number bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM), and the display row counter is initialised to zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a sequential forward read of the card file starting at or after the first card key (using GTEQ positioning)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads records one by one and collects up to a maximum of 7 matching credit card records; reading stops when 7 records have been collected or the end of the card file is reached

rules.rule_name: Apply Account ID Filter During Forward Read
rules.rule_description: During the forward read of card records, if the user has supplied a valid Account ID filter, only records whose account ID matches the filter value are included in the results; all others are skipped.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Apply Account ID Filter if Account Filter is Active

acceptance_criteria.Given: A forward read of the card file is in progress and the user has entered a valid numeric Account ID filter (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: Each card record is read from the file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system compares the card record's Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) against the user-supplied Account ID filter value (CC-ACCT-ID); if they match the record is included for display, and if they do not match the record is excluded and skipped silently

rules.rule_name: Apply Card Number Filter During Forward Read
rules.rule_description: During the forward read of card records, if the user has supplied a valid Card Number filter, only records whose card number matches the filter value are included in the results; all others are skipped.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Apply Card Number Filter if Card Number Filter is Active

acceptance_criteria.Given: A forward read of the card file is in progress and the user has entered a valid numeric Card Number filter (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: Each card record is read from the file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system compares the card record's Card Number (CARD-NUM) against the user-supplied Card Number filter value (CC-CARD-NUM-N); if they match the record is included for display, and if they do not match the record is excluded and skipped silently

rules.rule_name: Collect Matching Card Record Data for Display
rules.rule_description: For each card record that passes all active filters, the system collects the Account Number, Card Number, and Card Active Status and stores them in the corresponding display row slot for screen population.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Collect Matching Records: Account Number, Card Number, Card Active Status

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has been read from the file and has passed all active filter checks (account ID filter and card number filter where applicable)
acceptance_criteria.When: The record is confirmed as not excluded (WS-DONOT-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system increments the display row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) by 1 and stores the following data into the corresponding display row: Card Number (CARD-NUM) into WS-ROW-CARD-NUM, Account Number (CARD-ACCT-ID) into WS-ROW-ACCTNO, and Card Active Status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) into WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS for that row position

rules.rule_name: Set Advisory Message for Page Up on First Page
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7 while already on the first page, the system sets an advisory error message to inform the user that there are no previous pages available to navigate to.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Message: 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 (Page Up) and the current page is the first page (CA-FIRST-PAGE is TRUE), and neither the Account ID filter nor the Card Number filter is in an invalid state
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the message area for screen display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error message field (WS-ERROR-MSG) to 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY', which will be shown to the user on the redisplayed screen

rules.rule_name: Populate Screen with First Page Card Results
rules.rule_description: After re-reading the first page records and setting the advisory message, the system populates all screen fields including card data rows, filter fields, screen header information, and field attributes, then sends the completed screen to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Screen with Same First Page Results

acceptance_criteria.Given: The forward read from the first card key has completed, up to 7 matching card records have been collected, and the advisory message 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY' has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system builds and sends the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the screen with: (1) screen header fields including current date, current time, transaction ID, program name, and current page number; (2) up to 7 card data rows each showing Account Number, Card Number, and Card Active Status; (3) selection fields set as editable for rows with data and protected for empty rows; (4) the advisory error message 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY' in the error message area; and (5) the completed screen is sent to the user with the keyboard unlocked and the previous screen erased

key_functionalities.title: Page Down Navigation
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([PF8 Page Down Pressed])
    B{Next Page\nExists?}
    C[Set Starting Position\nUse last card key from\ncurrent page as new\nstarting point]
    D[Advance Page Number\nIncrement screen number\nby 1]
    E[Clear Screen Data\nReset all 7 card rows\nto prepare for new page data]
    F[Browse Card File Forward\nStart browsing from the\nlast card key position]
    G[Read Next Card Record]
    H{Apply Search Filters\nDoes record match\naccount ID filter AND\ncard number filter?}
    I[Skip Record\nRecord does not match\nactive search filters]
    J[Add Record to Page\nStore card number, account ID,\nand card active status\nin next available row]
    K{First Record\non New Page?}

    P{More Records\nExist Beyond\nThis Page?}

    X[Set Navigation Message\nShow action instructions\nor no more pages message\nbased on page indicators]

    Z([Page Down Complete\nUser Views Next Page])

    A --> B

    M -->|Yes - Page Full| N

rules.rule_name: Verify Next Page Availability Before Page Down Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before navigating to the next page, the system must verify that a next page of card records actually exists. If no next page is available, the user remains on the current page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Next Page Exists?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing a page of credit card records on the Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 (Page Down)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the next-page-available indicator is set to TRUE, the system proceeds with forward navigation to the next page; if the next-page-available indicator is FALSE (no more pages exist), the system keeps the user on the current page without any navigation

rules.rule_name: Set Starting Position for Next Page Read Using Last Card Key
rules.rule_description: When navigating forward to the next page, the system uses the last card number displayed on the current page as the starting key to read the next set of records from the card file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Starting Position - Use last card key from current page as new starting point

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 and a next page of card records is confirmed to exist, and the current page has a recorded last card number bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to read the next page of card records
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the card file read starting position (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) to the value of the last card number from the current page (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM), so that the forward read begins from the record immediately following the last displayed card

rules.rule_name: Increment Page Number When Navigating to Next Page
rules.rule_description: Each time the user successfully navigates to the next page, the current page number counter is incremented by 1 to reflect the new page being displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Advance Page Number - Increment screen number by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8, a next page exists, and the system is preparing to display the next page of card records
acceptance_criteria.When: The system advances to the next page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen/page number counter (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is incremented by exactly 1, and this updated page number is displayed in the screen header

rules.rule_name: Clear All Card Display Rows Before Loading New Page Data
rules.rule_description: Before populating the screen with the next page of card records, all 7 card display rows must be cleared to prevent stale data from the previous page from appearing on the new page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear Screen Data - Reset all 7 card rows to prepare for new page data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to display a new page of card records after a PF8 navigation
acceptance_criteria.When: The forward read process (9000-READ-FORWARD) is initiated
acceptance_criteria.Then: All 7 card display rows (WS-ALL-ROWS, which encompasses WS-ROW-CARD-NUM, WS-ROW-ACCTNO, and WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS for rows 1 through 7) are reset to LOW-VALUES before any new records are loaded

rules.rule_name: Start Browsing Card File Forward from Last Card Key Position
rules.rule_description: The system initiates a forward browse of the card file starting at or after the specified card key position, using a greater-than-or-equal (GTEQ) positioning strategy to locate the correct starting record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Browse Card File Forward - Start browsing from the last card key position

acceptance_criteria.Given: The starting card key position has been set to the last card number from the previous page (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM), and all display rows have been cleared
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins reading card records for the new page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card file browse is initiated at the position greater than or equal to the specified card key (GTEQ), and the screen counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is initialized to zero, and the next-page-exists indicator is set to TRUE as a default before reading begins

rules.rule_name: Filter Card Records by Account ID
rules.rule_description: When an account ID filter has been entered and validated by the user, only card records whose account ID exactly matches the filter value are included in the page display; all non-matching records are excluded.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Apply Search Filters - Does record match account ID filter AND card number filter?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account ID filter flag (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID) is active, indicating the user has entered a valid account ID filter value (CC-ACCT-ID)
acceptance_criteria.When: Each card record is read from the card file during the forward browse
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the card record's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) exactly equals the filter account ID (CC-ACCT-ID), the record is included for display; if the card record's account ID does not match, the record is excluded (WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is set) and the system moves on to read the next record

rules.rule_name: Filter Card Records by Card Number
rules.rule_description: When a card number filter has been entered and validated by the user, only card records whose card number exactly matches the filter value are included in the page display; all non-matching records are excluded.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Apply Search Filters - Does record match account ID filter AND card number filter?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card number filter flag (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID) is active, indicating the user has entered a valid card number filter value (CC-CARD-NUM-N), and the record has already passed the account ID filter check (if applicable)
acceptance_criteria.When: Each card record is evaluated during the forward browse
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the card record's card number (CARD-NUM) exactly equals the filter card number (CC-CARD-NUM-N), the record is included for display; if the card number does not match, the record is excluded (WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is set) and the system moves on to read the next record

rules.rule_name: Skip Records That Do Not Match Active Search Filters
rules.rule_description: Card records that do not satisfy the active search filter criteria (account ID and/or card number) are silently skipped and not counted toward the page display limit, ensuring only matching records are shown to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip Record - Record does not match active search filters

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has been read from the card file and one or more search filters are active
acceptance_criteria.When: The record fails to match the active account ID filter or the active card number filter
acceptance_criteria.Then: The record is excluded from the display (WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD indicator is set), the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is NOT incremented, and the system immediately reads the next card record without adding any data to the display rows

rules.rule_name: Add Matching Card Record to the Current Page Display
rules.rule_description: Each card record that passes all active search filters is added to the next available display row on the current page, storing the card number, account ID, and card active status.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Add Record to Page - Store card number, account ID, and card active status in next available row

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has been read from the card file and has passed all active search filters (WS-DONOT-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is set)
acceptance_criteria.When: The record is confirmed to be included in the current page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is incremented by 1, and the card number (CARD-NUM) is stored in WS-ROW-CARD-NUM at the current counter position, the account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is stored in WS-ROW-ACCTNO at the current counter position, and the card active status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) is stored in WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS at the current counter position

rules.rule_name: Save First Card Key Bookmark When First Record Is Added to New Page
rules.rule_description: When the very first qualifying card record is added to a new page, its card number and account ID are saved as the first-card bookmark for the page, enabling backward navigation (PF7) to return to this page later.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save First Card Key - Record this card as the new first card key for this page

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has passed all filters and is being added to the display, and the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) has just been incremented to 1 (meaning this is the first record on the new page)
acceptance_criteria.When: The first qualifying record is stored in display row 1
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is saved to WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-ACCT-ID and the card's card number (CARD-NUM) is saved to WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM as the first-card bookmark for this page; additionally, if the page counter (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is currently 0, it is incremented by 1 to set the page number to 1

rules.rule_name: Detect When Current Page Has Reached Maximum Display Capacity of 7 Records
rules.rule_description: The system continuously checks whether the current page has been filled to its maximum capacity of 7 card records after each record is added, to determine when to stop reading and check for additional pages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Page Full? 7 Records Displayed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: Card records are being read and added to the current page display
acceptance_criteria.When: A card record is successfully added to the display and the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If WS-SCRN-COUNTER equals WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES (7), the page is considered full and the read loop is flagged to exit (READ-LOOP-EXIT set to TRUE); if WS-SCRN-COUNTER is less than 7, reading continues to fill the remaining rows

rules.rule_name: Save Last Card Key Bookmark When Page Is Full
rules.rule_description: When the page reaches its maximum of 7 records, the card number and account ID of the last displayed record are saved as the last-card bookmark, which will serve as the starting point for the next page-down navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save Last Card Key - Record current card as last card key for this page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The page has just been filled to its maximum capacity of 7 card records (WS-SCRN-COUNTER equals WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES)
acceptance_criteria.When: The read loop is flagged to exit after filling the page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current card's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is saved to WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and the current card's card number (CARD-NUM) is saved to WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM as the last-card bookmark for this page

rules.rule_name: Peek at Next Record to Determine If Another Page Exists
rules.rule_description: After filling a page with 7 records, the system attempts to read one additional record from the card file to determine whether more records exist beyond the current page, which controls whether the PF8 (Page Down) option will be available to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Peek at Next Record - Attempt to read one more record to check if another page exists

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current page has been filled with exactly 7 card records and the last-card bookmark has been saved
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a peek read of the next record in the card file
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the peek read returns a record successfully (normal or duplicate record response), the next-page-available indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) is set to TRUE and the peeked record's account ID and card number are updated into WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM; if the peek read reaches end of file, the no-more-pages indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) is set to TRUE and the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set (if no prior error message exists)

rules.rule_name: Mark Next Page as Available After Successful Peek Read
rules.rule_description: When the peek read confirms that additional card records exist beyond the current page, the system marks the next-page indicator as available so that the user can continue navigating forward with PF8.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Next Page Available - Set indicator that Page Down will be available to user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current page is full with 7 records and a peek read of the next record has been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: The peek read successfully retrieves a record (normal or duplicate record response)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next-page-available indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) is set to TRUE, and the peeked record's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is stored in WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and the peeked record's card number (CARD-NUM) is stored in WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM

rules.rule_name: Mark No More Pages Available When Peek Read Reaches End of File
rules.rule_description: When the peek read after filling a page confirms that no more records exist in the card file, the system marks the current page as the last page, preventing further forward navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark No More Pages - Set indicator that this is the last page of results

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current page is full with 7 records and a peek read of the next record has been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: The peek read reaches the end of the card file (end-of-file condition)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The no-more-pages indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) is set to TRUE, and if no prior error message has been set (WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF is TRUE), the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is placed in WS-ERROR-MSG

rules.rule_name: Mark No More Pages When End of Card File Is Reached During Normal Reading
rules.rule_description: When the card file reaches its end during normal forward reading (before filling 7 rows), the system marks the current page as the last page, stops reading, and if no records were found on the first page, sets a no-records-found indicator.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End of Card File? / Mark No More Pages - Set last page indicator and stop reading

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is reading card records forward to fill the current page and has not yet reached 7 records
acceptance_criteria.When: The end of the card file is encountered during a READNEXT operation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The read loop is flagged to exit (READ-LOOP-EXIT set to TRUE), the no-more-pages indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) is set to TRUE, the last card's account ID and card number are saved to WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM, and if no prior error message exists the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set; additionally, if this is page 1 (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM = 1) and zero records were found (WS-SCRN-COUNTER = 0), the no-records-found indicator (WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND) is set to TRUE

rules.rule_name: Build Screen Header with Current Date, Time, and Page Number
rules.rule_description: Before sending the updated screen to the user, the system populates the screen header with standard information including screen titles, transaction ID, program name, current date, current time, and the updated page number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Build Screen Header - Populate titles, transaction ID, program name, date, time, and new page number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed reading card records for the new page and is preparing to display the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen initialization process (1100-SCREEN-INIT) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen output area (CCRDLIAO) is cleared to LOW-VALUES, and the following fields are populated: screen title line 1 (TITLE01O) from CCDA-TITLE01, screen title line 2 (TITLE02O) from CCDA-TITLE02, transaction ID (TRNNAMEO) from LIT-THISTRANID, program name (PGMNAMEO) from LIT-THISPGM, current date in MM/DD/YY format (CURDATEO), current time in HH:MM:SS format (CURTIMEO), and the current page number (PAGENOO) from WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM

rules.rule_name: Populate Up to 7 Card Display Rows with Card Data
rules.rule_description: The screen is populated with card data for each of the up to 7 rows, displaying the selection field, account number, card number, and card active status for each row that contains data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Card Rows - Fill up to 7 rows with card number, account number, and active status

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header has been initialized and card records have been loaded into the work storage rows (WS-EACH-CARD 1 through 7)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen array initialization process (1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: For each of the 7 possible rows (1 through 7): if the row's data (WS-EACH-CARD) is equal to LOW-VALUES (empty), the row is left blank on screen; if the row contains data, the selection field (CRDSELnO), account number (ACCTNOnO), card number (CRDNUMnO), and card active status (CRDSTSnO) are populated from WS-EDIT-SELECT(n), WS-ROW-ACCTNO(n), WS-ROW-CARD-NUM(n), and WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS(n) respectively

rules.rule_name: Set Row Selection Field Attributes Based on Data Availability and Protection Status
rules.rule_description: Each card row's selection field is set to either enterable (allowing the user to type 'S' or 'U') or protected (read-only) based on whether the row contains card data and whether the selection rows are globally protected due to a filter validation error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Row Display Attributes - Make rows with data enterable, protect empty rows

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen card rows have been populated with available card data
acceptance_criteria.When: The row display attributes setup process (1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS) is executed for each of the 7 rows
acceptance_criteria.Then: For each row (1 through 7): if the row is empty (WS-EACH-CARD equals LOW-VALUES) OR the global protect-rows flag (FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES) is active, the row's selection field attribute is set to protected (DFHBMPRF for row 1, DFHBMPRO for rows 2-7); if the row contains data AND protect-rows is not active, the selection field is set to enterable (DFHBMFSE); additionally, if a row has a selection error flag set to '1', the selection field color is set to red (DFHRED) and if the selection value is blank or LOW-VALUES for row 1, an asterisk '*' is displayed in the selection field

rules.rule_name: Set Navigation and Informational Messages Based on Page Position and Indicators
rules.rule_description: After reading records and building the screen, the system determines and sets the appropriate informational or error message to guide the user, based on the current page position, filter status, and whether more pages exist.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Navigation Message - Show action instructions or no more pages message based on page indicators

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen has been populated with card records and the system is finalizing the display for a PF8 page-down action
acceptance_criteria.When: The message setup process (1400-SETUP-MESSAGE) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following message logic applies in priority order: (1) if account or card filter is invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK or FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), no informational message is set and processing continues; (2) if PF8 was pressed and no next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) and the last page was already shown (CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN), the error message 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' is set in WS-ERROR-MSG; (3) if PF8 was pressed and no next page exists and the last page has NOT yet been shown (CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN), the informational action message (WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS) is set and CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is set to TRUE; (4) if no info message condition or next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS), the informational action message is set; the final error message (WS-ERROR-MSG) is moved to ERRMSGO and if an informational message is active and no-records-found is not set, the info message (WS-INFO-MSG) is moved to INFOMSGO with neutral color (DFHNEUTR)

rules.rule_name: Send Updated Card List Screen to User Terminal
rules.rule_description: After all screen data, attributes, and messages have been prepared, the completed screen is transmitted to the user's terminal, erasing the previous screen content and displaying the new page of card records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send Updated Screen - Display new page of credit card records to user terminal

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen has been fully prepared with card data, row attributes, header information, and navigation messages
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen send process (1500-SEND-SCREEN) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen map (LIT-THISMAP) from the mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET) is sent to the user terminal using the prepared output data (CCRDLIAO), the previous screen content is erased (ERASE), the cursor is positioned at the designated field (CURSOR), and the keyboard is unlocked (FREEKB) so the user can interact with the new page

rules.rule_name: Retain Current Page When No Next Page Is Available on PF8
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 but no next page of records exists, the system does not navigate forward. Instead, it redisplays the current page, preserving the existing page state and displaying an appropriate message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Stay on Current Page - No Next Page Available

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the last page of card records and the next-page-available indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) is FALSE
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 (Page Down)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The EVALUATE routing does not match the 'CCARD-AID-PFK08 AND CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS' condition, the system falls through to the default (WHEN OTHER) processing which performs a forward read from the first card bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM) and redisplays the current page; the page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is NOT incremented

rules.rule_name: Trigger Backward Page Navigation on PF7 When Not on First Page
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF7 (Page Up) and the current display is not the first page, the system initiates backward navigation to retrieve and display the previous page of card records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: PF7 Pressed AND Not on First Page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen and the current page is NOT the first page (CA-FIRST-PAGE flag is not set)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 (Page Up key)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system uses the first card number of the current page as the starting point, decrements the page number by 1, performs a backward read of the card file, and displays the previous page of card records

rules.rule_name: Set Starting Point for Backward Read Using Current First Card Key
rules.rule_description: Before initiating a backward read, the system sets the card file record identifier to the first card number of the currently displayed page, which serves as the anchor point for backward navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Current First Card Key as Starting Point for Backward Read

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has triggered backward page navigation (PF7 on a non-first page)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to read the previous page of card records
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the card file record identifier (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) to the first card number of the current page (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM) to use as the starting position for the backward browse

rules.rule_name: Decrement Page Number When Navigating to Previous Page
rules.rule_description: When navigating backward to the previous page, the system decrements the current screen/page number by 1 to reflect the correct page position in the display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Decrement Page Number by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is processing a backward page navigation request
acceptance_criteria.When: The backward read is initiated for the previous page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen page number counter (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is decremented by 1 so the page number displayed to the user correctly reflects the previous page

rules.rule_name: Save Current First Card Key as Last Card Key Reference Before Backward Read
rules.rule_description: Before performing the backward read, the system copies the current page's first card key to the last card key reference field, preserving navigation bookmarks for future forward/backward navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save Current First Card Key as Last Card Key Reference

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to navigate to the previous page
acceptance_criteria.When: The backward read procedure (9100-READ-BACKWARDS) is initiated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current first card key (WS-CA-FIRST-CARDKEY) is copied to the last card key reference (WS-CA-LAST-CARDKEY) to maintain accurate pagination bookmarks

rules.rule_name: Open Backward Browse on Card File from Current First Card Key
rules.rule_description: The system opens a browse session on the card file starting at or after the current first card key position, using a greater-than-or-equal positioning strategy to anchor the backward read.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Open Backward Browse on Card File from Current First Card Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has set the record identifier to the first card number of the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The backward browse is initiated on the card file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system opens a browse session on the card file (LIT-CARD-FILE) positioned at the record matching or immediately following the current first card key (GTEQ positioning), ready for backward reading

rules.rule_name: Skip One Record Backward to Position Before Current Page Start
rules.rule_description: After opening the backward browse, the system reads one record backward to move the file position to just before the start of the current page, so that subsequent backward reads retrieve records from the previous page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip One Record Backward to Position Before Current Page Start

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward browse session has been successfully opened on the card file at the current first card key position
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs the initial positioning read
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads one record backward (READPREV) to skip past the current page's first record; if this initial skip read returns a normal or duplicate record response, the screen counter is set to MAX-SCREEN-LINES + 1 (i.e., 8) and the system proceeds to fill rows; if the read fails with any other response, an error is recorded and backward navigation is aborted

rules.rule_name: Handle Skip Failure During Backward Positioning
rules.rule_description: If the initial backward skip read fails with an unexpected error, the system records the error details and terminates the backward read operation, displaying an error message to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip Failed - Error

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has opened a backward browse on the card file and is attempting the initial positioning skip read
acceptance_criteria.When: The initial READPREV returns an unexpected error response (not normal, not duplicate record, not end-of-file)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the operation name as 'READ', the file name, the response code, and the reason code into the error fields, sets the file error message as the error message to display, sets the read loop exit flag, and proceeds to close the browse session and display the error to the user

rules.rule_name: Initialize Screen Row Fill from Bottom Row Upward
rules.rule_description: The system fills the screen display array from the bottom row (row 7) upward toward row 1, because records are being read in reverse order from the card file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Start Filling Screen Rows from Bottom Row 7 Upward

acceptance_criteria.Given: The initial backward positioning skip has succeeded and the system is ready to populate the screen rows
acceptance_criteria.When: The backward read loop begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) starts at WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES + 1 (value 8), and each successfully filtered record decrements this counter by 1 before being placed in the corresponding screen row, so that the first record read (oldest/previous) fills row 7 and subsequent records fill rows 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 in order

rules.rule_name: Read Previous Record from Card File in Backward Loop
rules.rule_description: Within the backward read loop, the system continuously reads the previous record from the card file to retrieve card records in reverse order for display on the previous page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Previous Record from Card File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward read loop is active and more screen rows need to be filled
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the next record in the backward direction from the card file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs a READPREV operation on the card file (LIT-CARD-FILE) into the card record buffer, retrieving the card number, account ID, and active status fields for evaluation

rules.rule_name: Handle Read Error During Backward Loop
rules.rule_description: If an unexpected error occurs while reading a record during the backward loop, the system records the error details, exits the read loop, and proceeds to display an error message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Error

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward read loop is active and a READPREV operation has been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: The READPREV returns an unexpected error response (not normal, not duplicate record, not end-of-file)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the operation name as 'READ', the card file name, the response code, and the reason code into the error fields, sets the file error message as the error message, sets the read loop exit flag to terminate the loop, and proceeds to close the browse and display the error

rules.rule_name: Apply Account and Card Number Filters to Each Record During Backward Read
rules.rule_description: Each record read during backward navigation is evaluated against the active account ID and card number filters. Records that do not match the active filter criteria are excluded from the display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 27: Apply Account and Card Number Filters to This Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully read from the card file during backward navigation
acceptance_criteria.When: The filter evaluation is performed on the record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If an account ID filter is active (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID), the record's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) must equal the filter value (CC-ACCT-ID), otherwise the record is excluded; if a card number filter is active (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID), the record's card number (CARD-NUM) must equal the filter value (CC-CARD-NUM-N), otherwise the record is excluded; if both filters are active, both conditions must be satisfied for the record to be included; records passing all active filters are marked as 'do not exclude' and included in the display

rules.rule_name: Skip Filtered-Out Records and Continue Reading
rules.rule_description: When a card record does not pass the active filter criteria during backward navigation, it is silently skipped and the system continues reading the next previous record without decrementing the row counter.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Excluded by Filter

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has been read during backward navigation and filter evaluation has been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: The record does not match one or more active filter criteria (account ID filter or card number filter)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The record is excluded from the display (WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is set), the screen row counter is not decremented, no data is placed in any screen row for this record, and the system immediately reads the next previous record from the card file

rules.rule_name: Place Filtered Record Data into Next Available Screen Row
rules.rule_description: When a card record passes all active filters during backward navigation, its data is placed into the next available screen row (filling from bottom to top), populating the card number, account number, and active status fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Place Record Data in Next Available Row: Account Number, Card Number, Active Status

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has been read and has passed all active filter criteria during backward navigation
acceptance_criteria.When: The record is accepted for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system places the card number (CARD-NUM) into WS-ROW-CARD-NUM at the current screen counter position, the account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) into WS-ROW-ACCTNO at the current screen counter position, and the card active status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) into WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS at the current screen counter position

rules.rule_name: Move Up One Row in Screen Array After Placing Record
rules.rule_description: After placing a record into a screen row during backward navigation, the system decrements the row counter to move to the next row upward, maintaining the bottom-to-top fill order.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Move Up One Row in Screen Array

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully placed into a screen row during backward navigation
acceptance_criteria.When: The row placement is complete
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is decremented by 1 to point to the next row upward in the screen array

rules.rule_name: Detect All 7 Screen Rows Filled and Update First Card Bookmark
rules.rule_description: When the screen row counter reaches zero after decrementing, all 7 rows have been filled. The system records the last record placed (which is in row 1, the topmost row) as the new first card key bookmark for future navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: All 7 Rows Filled? / Update First Card Key to This Record's Card Number and Account

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has been placed into a screen row and the row counter has been decremented during backward navigation
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) reaches zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the read loop exit flag (READ-LOOP-EXIT) to terminate the backward read loop, updates the first card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-ACCT-ID) with the current record's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID), and updates the first card number bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM) with the current record's card number (CARD-NUM)

rules.rule_name: Handle End of File During Backward Read
rules.rule_description: When the backward read reaches the beginning of the card file before all 7 rows are filled, the system recognizes there are no more previous records and terminates the read loop.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End of File Reached / No More Previous Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward read loop is active and fewer than 7 screen rows have been filled
acceptance_criteria.When: The READPREV operation returns an end-of-file response indicating the beginning of the card file has been reached
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the read loop exit flag to terminate the backward read loop and proceeds to close the browse session; the screen will display only the records that were successfully retrieved (fewer than 7 rows may be populated)

rules.rule_name: Close Card File Browse Session After Backward Read
rules.rule_description: After the backward read loop completes (whether all rows are filled, end of file is reached, or an error occurs), the system closes the card file browse session to release the file resource.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Close Card File Browse Session

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward read loop has terminated for any reason (all rows filled, end of file, or read error)
acceptance_criteria.When: The backward read procedure concludes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system closes the card file browse session (ENDBR on LIT-CARD-FILE) to properly end the file browsing operation

rules.rule_name: Initialize Screen Header with Current Date, Time, Titles, and Page Number
rules.rule_description: Before sending the updated screen to the user, the system initializes the screen header area with the application titles, current date, current time, transaction ID, program name, and current page number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 14: Initialize Screen Header Titles, Date, Time, Page Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward read has completed and the system is preparing to display the updated card list screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen initialization step (1100-SCREEN-INIT) is performed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the screen output area (CCRDLIAO) with: the two application title lines (CCDA-TITLE01, CCDA-TITLE02), the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) in the transaction name field, the program name (LIT-THISPGM) in the program name field, the current date formatted as MM/DD/YY in the date field, the current time formatted as HH:MM:SS in the time field, and the current page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) in the page number field

rules.rule_name: Populate Screen Rows with Retrieved Card Data
rules.rule_description: The system populates each of the 7 screen display rows with the card data retrieved during the backward read, including the selection field value, account number, card number, and card active status for each row that contains data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 15: Populate Screen Rows with Retrieved Card Data: Selection, Account, Card, Status

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header has been initialized and card records have been retrieved via backward read
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen array population step (1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT) is performed
acceptance_criteria.Then: For each of the 7 screen rows (1 through 7): if the row's data area (WS-EACH-CARD) is not empty (not LOW-VALUES), the system copies the selection field value (WS-EDIT-SELECT) to the corresponding screen selection output field (CRDSELnO), the account number (WS-ROW-ACCTNO) to the account number output field (ACCTNOnO), the card number (WS-ROW-CARD-NUM) to the card number output field (CRDNUMnO), and the card active status (WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS) to the card status output field (CRDSTSnO); rows with empty data are left blank on screen

rules.rule_name: Set Row Display Attributes - Protect Empty Rows and Highlight Errors in Red
rules.rule_description: The system sets the display attributes for each of the 7 selection fields: empty rows and rows in error-protected state have their selection fields set to protected (non-enterable), while rows with errors are highlighted in red and rows with valid data are set to editable.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 16: Set Row Display Attributes Protect empty rows, Highlight errors in red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen rows have been populated with card data and the system is setting display attributes (1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS)
acceptance_criteria.When: The display attributes are configured for each of the 7 row selection fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: For each row 1 through 7: if the row data is empty (WS-EACH-CARD equals LOW-VALUES) OR the protect-select-rows flag is set (FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES), the selection field attribute is set to protected (DFHBMPRF for row 1, DFHBMPRO for rows 2-7); otherwise if the row has a selection error flag set to '1' (WS-ROW-CRDSELECT-ERROR), the selection field color is set to red (DFHRED) and for row 1 if the selection value is space or LOW-VALUES an asterisk '*' is placed in the field; for all non-empty, non-protected rows the selection field attribute is set to unprotected editable (DFHBMFSE)

rules.rule_name: Display Search Filter Values and Position Cursor on Screen
rules.rule_description: The system displays the current account ID and card number filter values in their respective screen fields, applies appropriate attributes, and positions the cursor to highlight any invalid filter fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 17: Display Search Filter Values and Position Cursor

acceptance_criteria.Given: The row display attributes have been set and the system is configuring filter field display (1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen filter fields and cursor position are configured
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the session is a fresh entry from the menu program, filter fields are left as-is; otherwise: for the account ID filter field - if the account filter is valid or invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK), display CC-ACCT-ID value with editable attribute; if account ID is zero display LOW-VALUES; otherwise display CDEMO-ACCT-ID with editable attribute; for the card number filter field - if the card filter is valid or invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), display CC-CARD-NUM value with editable attribute; if card number is zero display LOW-VALUES; otherwise display CDEMO-CARD-NUM with editable attribute; if the account filter is invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK), set the account field color to red and set cursor length to -1; if the card filter is invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), set the card field color to red and set cursor length to -1; if input is valid (INPUT-OK), set cursor length to -1 on the account ID field

rules.rule_name: Set Informational Message for Available Record Actions
rules.rule_description: The system determines and sets the appropriate informational or error message to display on the screen based on the current pagination state and navigation action performed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 18: Set Informational Message Action Instructions for Available Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen filter fields have been configured and the system is setting the screen message (1400-SETUP-MESSAGE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The message content is determined based on current state
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system evaluates conditions in priority order: if account or card filter is invalid, no message change is made (CONTINUE); else if PF7 was pressed and currently on the first page, set error message to 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY'; else if PF8 was pressed and no next page exists and the last page was already shown, set error message to 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY'; else if PF8 was pressed and no next page exists (last page not yet shown), set the informational message to the record action instructions and mark the last page as shown; else if no info message is set or a next page exists, set the informational message to the record action instructions; otherwise set no-info-message flag; the error message (WS-ERROR-MSG) is always moved to the screen error message field (ERRMSGO); if an informational message is active and no-records-found is not set, the informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) is displayed in the info message field (INFOMSGO) with neutral color (DFHNEUTR)

rules.rule_name: Send Updated Card List Screen to User Terminal
rules.rule_description: The system sends the fully prepared card list screen to the user's terminal, erasing the previous screen content and releasing the keyboard for the next user input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 19: Send Updated Screen to User Terminal

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen has been fully prepared with header, card data rows, attributes, filter values, and messages
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen send step (1500-SEND-SCREEN) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sends the screen map (LIT-THISMAP) from the mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET) using the output data area (CCRDLIAO) to the user's terminal with cursor positioning enabled, the previous screen content erased (ERASE), and the keyboard released (FREEKB) for the next user interaction

rules.rule_name: Save Session State After Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: After displaying the previous page, the system saves the current session state including card key bookmarks, page number, and pagination indicators to the communication area so navigation can continue correctly on the next user interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 28: Save Session State Card Keys, Page Number, Pagination Indicators

acceptance_criteria.Given: The updated card list screen has been sent to the user after backward navigation
acceptance_criteria.When: The session state is saved in the COMMON-RETURN procedure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) in CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, the program name (LIT-THISPGM) in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, the map set name (LIT-THISMAPSET) in CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET, and the map name (LIT-THISMAP) in CDEMO-LAST-MAP; the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is copied to WS-COMMAREA and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is appended to WS-COMMAREA; the system then returns to CICS with the transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) and the combined communication area (WS-COMMAREA) so that the first card key bookmark, last card key bookmark, page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM), and pagination indicators (CA-FIRST-PAGE, CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) are preserved for the next user interaction

key_functionalities.title: Transfer to Card Detail View
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Enter Key Pressed])
    B{Is action code 'S'\nView selected on\na card row?}
    C{Is user returning\nfrom this same\nprogram?}
    D[Retrieve selected row details:\nAccount ID and Card Number\nfrom the selected card row]
    E[Set destination as\nCard Detail Program\nCOCRDSLC]
    F[Pass selected Account ID\nand Card Number in the\ncommunication area]
    G([Transfer control to\nCard Detail Program\nCOCRDSLC])
    H([Continue with\nother processing])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Action code is S| C
    B -->|No - Different action code| H
    C -->|Yes - Valid program context| D
    C -->|No - Invalid context| H
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G

rules.rule_name: Detect Enter Key Press for Card Row Action
rules.rule_description: The system identifies whether the user pressed the Enter key to trigger a card row action. Any unrecognized key press is treated as an Enter key press to ensure the screen processes the user's input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Enter Key Pressed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and has pressed a key
acceptance_criteria.When: The key pressed is not one of the recognized navigation keys (Enter, PF3, PF7, or PF8)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system treats the key press as an Enter key press and proceeds with Enter key processing logic

rules.rule_name: Validate View Action Code Selected on Card Row
rules.rule_description: The system checks whether the user has entered the View action code 'S' in exactly one card row's selection field before pressing Enter. This determines whether the user intends to view the details of a specific card.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is action code 'S' View selected on a card row?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and has pressed the Enter key
acceptance_criteria.When: The user has entered action code 'S' (View) in one of the seven card row selection fields and the row selection validation has identified the selected row index (I-SELECTED)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system recognizes a View action request on the selected card row and proceeds to verify the program context before transferring to the Card Detail screen; if no 'S' action code is found, the system continues with other processing logic

rules.rule_name: Validate Program Context for Card Detail Navigation
rules.rule_description: The system verifies that the current interaction originated from the Card List program itself (COCRDSLI), ensuring the user is in a valid session context before allowing navigation to the Card Detail screen. This prevents unauthorized or out-of-context transfers.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is user returning from this same program?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed Enter with action code 'S' selected on a card row
acceptance_criteria.When: The originating program recorded in the communication area is equal to the Card List program identifier (LIT-THISPGM / COCRDSLI)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system confirms a valid program context and proceeds to retrieve the selected card's details for transfer; if the originating program is not the Card List program, the system skips the Card Detail transfer and continues with other processing

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Selected Card Row Account and Card Number
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the Account ID and Card Number from the specific card row the user selected with action code 'S'. These values are sourced from the currently displayed card list rows and will be passed to the Card Detail program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Retrieve selected row details:
Account ID and Card Number
from the selected card row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed Enter with action code 'S' on a card row and the program context has been validated as the Card List program
acceptance_criteria.When: The system identifies the selected row index (I-SELECTED) from the card list display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Account ID (WS-ROW-ACCTNO at position I-SELECTED) and the Card Number (WS-ROW-CARD-NUM at position I-SELECTED) from the displayed card list rows and stores them as the target Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and target Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) in the communication area

rules.rule_name: Set Card Detail Program as Navigation Destination
rules.rule_description: The system designates the Card Detail program (COCRDSLC) as the next program to be invoked, along with its associated map and mapset, establishing the complete navigation destination for the card view action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set destination as
Card Detail Program
COCRDSLC

acceptance_criteria.Given: The selected card row's Account ID and Card Number have been retrieved
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to transfer control for a View action
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the next program to the Card Detail program (LIT-CARDDTLPGM / COCRDSLC), sets the next mapset to the Card Detail mapset (LIT-CARDDTLMAPSET), and sets the next map to the Card Detail map (LIT-CARDDTLMAP)

rules.rule_name: Pass Selected Card Details in Communication Area and Transfer to Card Detail Program
rules.rule_description: The system populates the communication area with the selected card's Account ID and Card Number, records the originating program context, and transfers control to the Card Detail program (COCRDSLC) so the detail screen can display the correct card information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Pass selected Account ID
and Card Number in the
communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Detail program (COCRDSLC) has been set as the navigation destination and the selected card's Account ID and Card Number are ready
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the transfer to the Card Detail program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the current transaction ID as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), records the Card List program as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), sets the user type to standard user (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER), sets the program state to entering (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER), records the current mapset (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET) and map (CDEMO-LAST-MAP), places the selected Account ID into the communication area field CDEMO-ACCT-ID, places the selected Card Number into the communication area field CDEMO-CARD-NUM, and transfers control to the Card Detail program (COCRDSLC) passing the fully populated communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)

rules.rule_name: Bypass Card Detail Transfer for Non-View Actions
rules.rule_description: When the Enter key is pressed but the action code is not 'S' (View), or the program context is not the Card List program, the system bypasses the Card Detail transfer and continues evaluating other applicable processing paths such as Update, error handling, or default display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Continue with
other processing

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed the Enter key on the Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: Either the action code entered is not 'S' (View) on any card row, or the originating program in the communication area is not the Card List program (COCRDSLI)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system does not transfer to the Card Detail program and instead continues evaluating the remaining processing conditions in the main action routing logic (such as Update action 'U', error conditions, or default forward read)

key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
