rules.rule_name: Validate Update Action Code and Request Origin Before Card Update Transfer
rules.rule_description: When a user presses Enter on the Card List screen, the system must verify that the selected row has an update action code ('U') AND that the request is originating from the Card List program itself before proceeding with the card update transfer. If either condition fails, the update transfer is bypassed and normal processing continues.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Action Code 'U' for Update Selected on a Row? / Is Request Originating from This Program?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and has entered an action code in one of the seven card rows
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the Enter key and the system evaluates the submitted action
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds with the Card Update transfer ONLY IF: (1) the action code entered on the selected row is 'U' (Update), AND (2) the request is originating from the Card List program (COCRDSLI) itself. If the action code is not 'U', or if the request did not originate from the Card List program, the update transfer is bypassed and processing continues with other applicable logic.

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Selected Card Account ID and Card Number for Update
rules.rule_description: Once the update action is confirmed valid, the system retrieves the Account ID and Card Number from the specific card row that the user selected with the 'U' action code, to be passed to the Card Update program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Identify Selected Row / Retrieve Account ID and Card Number from Selected Row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered action code 'U' on one of the seven displayed card rows and pressed Enter, and the request has been confirmed as originating from the Card List program
acceptance_criteria.When: The system identifies the selected row index (I-SELECTED) corresponding to the row where 'U' was entered
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Account ID (WS-ROW-ACCTNO of the selected row) and the Card Number (WS-ROW-CARD-NUM of the selected row) from the selected card row and stores them as the target Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and target Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) in the communication area for passing to the Card Update program.

rules.rule_name: Prepare Communication Area Context for Card Update Program Transfer
rules.rule_description: Before transferring control to the Card Update program, the system must populate the communication area with the current program context, including the originating transaction ID, originating program name, user type, program entry state, last map and mapset used, and the target Card Update program details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Prepare Communication Area / Set Selected Account ID / Set Selected Card Number / Set Current Program Context

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has confirmed the update action code 'U' is valid and the selected card's Account ID and Card Number have been retrieved
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the communication area for the transfer to the Card Update program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the following fields in the communication area: (1) Originating Transaction ID is set to the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID), (2) Originating Program is set to the Card List program name (LIT-THISPGM / COCRDSLI), (3) User Type is set to regular User, (4) Program State is set to Enter (first-time entry), (5) Last Mapset is set to the Card List mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET), (6) Last Map is set to the Card List map (LIT-THISMAP), (7) Next Program is set to the Card Update program name (LIT-CARDUPDPGM / COCRDUPC), (8) Next Mapset is set to the Card Update mapset (LIT-CARDUPDMAPSET), (9) Next Map is set to the Card Update map (LIT-CARDUPDMAP).

rules.rule_name: Transfer Control to Card Update Program with Selected Card Details
rules.rule_description: After the communication area is fully prepared with the selected card's Account ID, Card Number, and program context, the system transfers control directly to the Card Update program (COCRDUPC), passing the complete communication area so the Card Update screen is displayed to the user with the correct card pre-loaded.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Transfer Control to Card Update Program COCRDUPC Passing Account ID and Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The communication area has been fully populated with the selected card's Account ID, Card Number, current program context, and the Card Update program as the target next program
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the program transfer
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is transferred to the Card Update program (COCRDUPC) with the complete communication area passed, containing the selected Account ID and Card Number, so that the Card Update screen is displayed to the user pre-loaded with the correct card record for updating. The Card List program terminates its current execution cycle upon transfer.

rules.rule_name: Set Starting Position for Forward Browse Using First Card Key
rules.rule_description: When the default forward read is triggered (all other conditions), the system uses the stored first card key as the starting position for browsing the credit card file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Starting Position
Use First Card Key as
Starting Point for Browse

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is in the default/other condition path and needs to display or refresh the credit card list
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to read forward through the credit card file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The first card key stored in the session (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM) is set as the starting record identifier (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) for the forward browse operation

rules.rule_name: Clear All Screen Rows Before Populating New Page
rules.rule_description: Before reading and populating card records onto the screen, all 7 display rows must be cleared to ensure no stale data from a previous page is shown to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear All Screen Rows
Reset all 7 card data rows
to empty before populating

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to perform a forward read to populate the credit card list screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The forward read process (9000-READ-FORWARD) is initiated
acceptance_criteria.Then: All 7 card data rows on the screen are reset to empty (LOW-VALUES), ensuring no previously displayed card data remains visible

rules.rule_name: Open Forward Browse on Credit Card File from Starting Position
rules.rule_description: The system opens a forward browse on the Credit Card file starting at or after the specified card key position, using a greater-than-or-equal (GTEQ) positioning strategy.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Open Forward Browse
Start browsing Credit Card file
from the starting card key position

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen rows have been cleared and the starting card key (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates a browse on the Credit Card file
acceptance_criteria.Then: A forward browse is opened on the Credit Card file starting at the first record whose key is greater than or equal to the specified starting card key, and the screen row counter is initialized to zero

rules.rule_name: Read Next Credit Card Record During Forward Browse
rules.rule_description: During the forward browse loop, the system sequentially reads the next available credit card record from the Credit Card file to evaluate it for display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Read Next Card Record
Read next available
credit card record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A forward browse is open on the Credit Card file and the screen is not yet full (fewer than 7 records populated)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the next record in the forward browse loop
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next credit card record is retrieved from the Credit Card file into the card record buffer; if the read is successful (normal or duplicate record), processing continues to filter evaluation; if end of file is reached, the end-of-file handling path is taken

rules.rule_name: Apply Account ID Filter to Credit Card Records
rules.rule_description: When an Account ID filter has been provided by the user, each retrieved credit card record is checked to determine whether its account ID matches the filter value. Records that do not match are excluded from display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Apply Search Filters
Check if record matches
Account ID filter if set
Check if record matches
Card Number filter if set

acceptance_criteria.Given: A credit card record has been successfully read from the file and an Account ID filter is active (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID is set)
acceptance_criteria.When: The filter check (9500-FILTER-RECORDS) is performed on the record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the record's Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) matches the filter Account ID (CC-ACCT-ID), the record is retained for further evaluation; if the Account ID does not match, the record is excluded and the system moves on to read the next record without adding it to the display

rules.rule_name: Apply Card Number Filter to Credit Card Records
rules.rule_description: When a Card Number filter has been provided by the user, each retrieved credit card record is checked to determine whether its card number matches the filter value. Records that do not match are excluded from display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Apply Search Filters
Check if record matches
Account ID filter if set
Check if record matches
Card Number filter if set

acceptance_criteria.Given: A credit card record has passed the Account ID filter check (or no Account ID filter is active) and a Card Number filter is active (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID is set)
acceptance_criteria.When: The card number filter check (9500-FILTER-RECORDS) is performed on the record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the record's Card Number (CARD-NUM) matches the filter Card Number (CC-CARD-NUM-N), the record is retained for display; if the Card Number does not match, the record is excluded and the system moves on to read the next record without adding it to the display

rules.rule_name: Add Matching Credit Card Record to Screen Display Row
rules.rule_description: When a credit card record passes all active filters, its key data fields are stored in the next available screen display row for presentation to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Add Record to Screen Row
Store Card Number,
Account ID, and
Card Active Status

acceptance_criteria.Given: A credit card record has passed all active filter checks and is eligible for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The record is added to the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen row counter is incremented by 1, and the record's Card Number (CARD-NUM), Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID), and Card Active Status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) are stored in the corresponding screen row fields (WS-ROW-CARD-NUM, WS-ROW-ACCTNO, WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS) at the position indicated by the screen row counter

rules.rule_name: Save First Card Key and Set Page Number on First Record
rules.rule_description: When the first qualifying record is added to the screen (screen row counter becomes 1), the system saves its account ID and card number as the first-card bookmark for backward (page-up) navigation, and initializes the page number to 1 if it has not been set yet.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Is This the
First Record?
Save as First Card Key
Record first card key
for page-up navigation
Set page number to 1 if needed

acceptance_criteria.Given: A credit card record has just been added to the screen and the screen row counter equals 1 (this is the first record on the page)
acceptance_criteria.When: The first-record check is performed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The record's Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is saved as the first card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-ACCT-ID), the record's Card Number (CARD-NUM) is saved as the first card number bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM), and if the current page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is zero, it is incremented by 1 to set it to page 1

rules.rule_name: Detect Screen Full Condition After 7 Records Are Populated
rules.rule_description: After each record is added to the screen, the system checks whether the maximum number of displayable records (7) has been reached to determine whether to stop reading and check for additional pages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Screen Full?
7 Records Reached?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A credit card record has been added to the screen display
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the screen is full
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) equals the maximum screen lines (WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES, which is 7), the screen is considered full and the system proceeds to save the last card key and check for more records; if the counter is less than 7, the system continues reading the next record

rules.rule_name: Save Last Card Key When Screen Is Full
rules.rule_description: When the screen has been filled with 7 records, the system saves the account ID and card number of the last displayed record as a bookmark to support forward (page-down) navigation to the next page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Save Last Card Key
Record last card key
for page-down navigation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen has been filled with the maximum number of records (7) and the screen full condition has been detected
acceptance_criteria.When: The last card key is saved
acceptance_criteria.Then: The last displayed record's Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is saved as the last card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID) and the last displayed record's Card Number (CARD-NUM) is saved as the last card number bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM)

rules.rule_name: Peek Ahead to Determine If a Next Page of Records Exists
rules.rule_description: After filling the screen with 7 records, the system reads one additional record beyond the last displayed record to determine whether more records exist, enabling the system to correctly indicate whether a next page is available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Check for More Records
Read one additional record
to determine if next
page exists

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen has been filled with 7 records and the last card key bookmark has been saved
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a peek-ahead read of one additional record from the Credit Card file
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the additional record is read successfully (normal or duplicate), the next page is marked as available (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) and the last card key bookmarks (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM) are updated to this next record's values; if end of file is reached, no next page is marked (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) and the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set (if no prior error message exists)

rules.rule_name: Mark Next Page as Available When More Records Exist Beyond Current Page
rules.rule_description: When the peek-ahead read confirms that at least one more record exists beyond the current page, the system marks the next page as available and updates the last card key bookmark to the position of that next record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
More Records
Exist Beyond
This Page?
Mark Next Page Available
Update last card key to
next record position

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen is full with 7 records and a peek-ahead read has been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: The peek-ahead read returns a record successfully (normal or duplicate response)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next page indicator is set to available (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS is TRUE), and the last card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID) and last card number bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM) are updated to the peek-ahead record's Account ID and Card Number respectively

rules.rule_name: Mark No More Pages When End of File Reached After Full Screen
rules.rule_description: When the peek-ahead read after filling the screen reaches end of file, the system marks that no further pages exist, indicating to the user that the current page is the last page of results.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
More Records
Exist Beyond
This Page?
Mark No More Pages
Set indicator that this
is the last page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen is full with 7 records and a peek-ahead read has been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: The peek-ahead read reaches end of file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next page indicator is set to not available (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is TRUE), and the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set if no prior error message has been set (WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF is TRUE)

rules.rule_name: Handle End of File During Forward Read Before Screen Is Full
rules.rule_description: When the end of the Credit Card file is reached during the forward read loop before the screen is filled, the system marks that no next page exists and records the last card key bookmarks from the final record read.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
End of
File Reached?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is reading records in the forward browse loop and the screen has fewer than 7 records
acceptance_criteria.When: End of file is reached on the Credit Card file during the READNEXT operation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The read loop is terminated, the next page indicator is set to not available (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is TRUE), the last card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID) and last card number bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM) are saved from the last record encountered, and the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set if no prior error message exists

rules.rule_name: Set No Records Found Message When First Page Returns Zero Matching Records
rules.rule_description: When the system is displaying the first page of results and end of file is reached with zero records having been added to the screen, the system sets a 'No Records Found' indicator to inform the user that no credit cards match the current search criteria.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
First Page AND
Zero Records Found?
Set No Records Found Message
Inform user no credit cards
match the current
search criteria

acceptance_criteria.Given: End of file has been reached during the forward read and the system is on page 1 (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM equals 1)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether any records were found
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) equals zero (no records were added to the screen), the No Records Found indicator (WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND) is set to TRUE, signaling that no credit cards match the current search criteria

rules.rule_name: Close Credit Card File Browse After Reading Is Complete
rules.rule_description: After all required records have been read (either the screen is full or end of file has been reached), the system closes the browse session on the Credit Card file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Card File Browse
End the browsing session
on the Credit Card file

acceptance_criteria.Given: The forward read loop has completed, either because the screen is full (7 records) or end of file has been reached
acceptance_criteria.When: The system finalizes the read operation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The browse session on the Credit Card file is closed (ENDBR is executed), releasing the file browse resources

rules.rule_name: Display Credit Card List Screen with Populated Records and Messages
rules.rule_description: After reading and filtering credit card records, the system builds and sends the credit card list screen to the user, showing all found card records along with appropriate navigation messages and field attributes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Credit Card List Screen
Show populated screen with
all found card records
and appropriate messages

acceptance_criteria.Given: The forward read is complete and the screen data rows have been populated with matching credit card records
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the credit card list screen to the user (1000-SEND-MAP)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is built with: (1) screen header including title, transaction ID, program name, current date, current time, and current page number; (2) up to 7 card rows each showing Account Number, Card Number, and Card Active Status; (3) selection fields set as editable for populated rows and protected for empty rows; (4) filter field values restored on screen; (5) appropriate messages such as 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' or informational action guidance; and the completed screen is sent to the user with the keyboard unlocked

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card List screen is about to be sent to the user

rules.rule_name: Populate Application Title Lines on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The screen header must display two standard application title lines sourced from the application's centrally defined title constants, ensuring consistent branding across the Card Demo application.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

rules.rule_description: The screen header must always display the transaction identifier associated with the current Card List transaction, allowing users to identify which transaction they are working within.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Transaction ID
Display current transaction
identifier on screen header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header is being initialized for the Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The transaction identifier field is being populated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction name field (TRNNAMEO) on the screen header is populated with the current transaction ID defined by the application literal LIT-THISTRANID

rules.rule_name: Display Current Program Name on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The screen header must always display the name of the currently executing program, providing users and support staff with clear identification of which program is active.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Program Name
Display current program
name on screen header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header is being initialized for the Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The program name field is being populated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program name field (PGMNAMEO) on the screen header is populated with the current program name defined by the application literal LIT-THISPGM

rules.rule_name: Retrieve and Format Current System Date for Screen Display
rules.rule_description: The screen header must display today's date in MM/DD/YY format. The system retrieves the current date, extracts the month, day, and last two digits of the year, assembles them into the standard display format, and places the result in the date field on the screen header.

Extract Month, Day, and

rules.rule_name: Protect Card Selection Field for Empty Row
rules.rule_description: When a card list display row contains no card data, the selection field for that row must be protected so the user cannot enter a selection action on an empty row.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Row Empty OR Rows Protected Due to Input Errors?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card list screen is being prepared for display and a card selection row (any of rows 1 through 7) contains no card data (row data equals LOW-VALUES)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the display attributes for that row's selection field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field for that row is set to protected mode, preventing the user from entering any value in that field

rules.rule_name: Protect All Card Selection Fields When Input Errors Exist
rules.rule_description: When account or card filter validation errors exist, all card selection fields across all 7 rows must be protected to prevent the user from attempting to select a card while filter inputs are invalid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Row Empty OR Rows Protected Due to Input Errors?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card list screen is being prepared for display and the system has flagged that selection rows must be protected due to input validation errors (e.g., invalid account filter or invalid card filter)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the display attributes for each of the 7 card selection rows
acceptance_criteria.Then: All 7 card selection fields are set to protected mode regardless of whether the rows contain card data, preventing the user from entering any selection value on any row

rules.rule_name: Highlight Card Selection Field in Red When Row Has a Selection Error
rules.rule_description: When a card row contains data and is not protected, but the user entered an invalid or conflicting selection value on that row, the selection field must be visually highlighted in red to draw attention to the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does This Row Have a Selection Error?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card list screen is being prepared for display, a card selection row (any of rows 1 through 7) contains card data, the rows are not globally protected, and the row's selection error indicator is set to '1'
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the display attributes for that row's selection field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field for that row is highlighted in red color to indicate an error condition on that specific row

rules.rule_name: Mark First Row Selection Field with Error Symbol When Value is Blank
rules.rule_description: For the first card row specifically, when a selection error exists but the selection field is blank or empty, the system must place an asterisk '*' symbol in the field to visually indicate that an action was expected but not provided.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Selection Value Blank or Empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card list screen is being prepared for display, row 1 contains card data, the row is not globally protected, row 1 has a selection error indicator set to '1', and the current selection value for row 1 is a space or LOW-VALUES (blank or empty)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the display attributes for row 1's selection field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field for row 1 is populated with the asterisk character '*' as an error symbol to indicate a missing required selection value

rules.rule_name: Make Card Selection Field Enterable When Row Has Valid Data and No Errors
rules.rule_description: When a card row contains valid card data, the rows are not globally protected, and there is no selection error on that row, the selection field must be made enterable so the user can input a valid action code (View 'S' or Update 'U').
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Make Row Field Enterable by User

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card list screen is being prepared for display, a card selection row (any of rows 1 through 7) contains card data, the rows are not globally protected due to input errors, and the row has no selection error indicator set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the display attributes for that row's selection field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field for that row is set to an enterable and storable mode, allowing the user to type a selection action code ('S' for View or 'U' for Update) into that field

rules.rule_name: Process All 7 Card Selection Rows for Attribute Configuration
rules.rule_description: The screen attribute setup must evaluate and configure every one of the 7 card selection rows individually, applying the appropriate display state (protected, error-highlighted, or enterable) to each row based on its specific data and error conditions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Process Each of 7 Card Selection Rows
Rows 1 through 7

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card list screen is being prepared for display with up to 7 card records loaded into the display rows
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs the screen row attribute setup
acceptance_criteria.Then: Each of the 7 card selection rows (rows 1 through 7) is individually evaluated and configured with the correct display attribute — protected if empty or globally protected, red-highlighted if a selection error exists, or enterable if the row has valid data and no errors — and all 7 rows are processed before the screen is sent to the user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is returning to the Card List screen, the account ID filter is in a blank/neutral state (neither FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID nor FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK), and the account ID stored in the session (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is a non-zero value

acceptance_criteria.Then: The erroneous card number value (CC-CARD-NUM) that was entered by the user is displayed in the card number filter field on the screen, and the field attribute is set to allow user entry so the user can correct the invalid value

rules.rule_name: Clear Card Number Filter Field When Session Card Number Is Zero
rules.rule_description: When the card number filter is neither valid nor in error (blank state), and the session card number value is zero, the card number filter field is cleared on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number in Session = Zero? → Yes - Zero → Clear Card Number Filter Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is returning to the Card List screen, the card number filter is in a blank/neutral state (neither FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID nor FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), and the card number stored in the session (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) equals zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen display setup is preparing the card number filter field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card number filter field on the screen is cleared (set to low-values/empty), displaying no value to the user

rules.rule_name: Display Session Card Number Value When Non-Zero
rules.rule_description: When the card number filter is in a neutral state and the session contains a non-zero card number value, that session card number is displayed in the filter field and made editable.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number in Session = Zero? → No - Has Value → Display Session Card Number Value Make Field Enterable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is returning to the Card List screen, the card number filter is in a blank/neutral state (neither FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID nor FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), and the card number stored in the session (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is a non-zero value
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen display setup is preparing the card number filter field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The session card number value (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is displayed in the card number filter field on the screen, and the field attribute is set to allow user entry (field is unprotected and editable)

rules.rule_name: Highlight Account ID Filter Field in Red When Validation Error Exists
rules.rule_description: When the account ID filter field contains an invalid value, the field is visually highlighted in red on the screen and the cursor is automatically positioned at the account ID field to direct the user to correct the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account ID Filter Has Validation Error? → Yes → Highlight Account ID Field in Red Place Cursor at Account ID Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card List screen is being prepared for display and the account ID filter field has been marked as having a validation error (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set up for the account ID filter field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The account ID filter field color attribute is set to red (DFHRED) to visually indicate the error, and the cursor length attribute is set to position the cursor at the account ID filter field (ACCTSIDL set to -1), directing the user to correct the invalid account ID value

rules.rule_name: Highlight Card Number Filter Field in Red When Validation Error Exists
rules.rule_description: When the card number filter field contains an invalid value, the field is visually highlighted in red on the screen and the cursor is automatically positioned at the card number field to direct the user to correct the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number Filter Has Validation Error? → Yes → Highlight Card Number Field in Red Place Cursor at Card Number Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card List screen is being prepared for display and the card number filter field has been marked as having a validation error (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set up for the card number filter field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card number filter field color attribute is set to red (DFHRED) to visually indicate the error, and the cursor length attribute is set to position the cursor at the card number filter field (CARDSIDL set to -1), directing the user to correct the invalid card number value

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor at Account ID Field When All Inputs Are Valid
rules.rule_description: When all input fields on the Card List screen are valid with no errors, the cursor is automatically positioned at the account ID filter field as the default starting point for user interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: All Inputs Valid - No Errors? → Yes - No Errors → Place Cursor at Account ID Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card List screen is being prepared for display and all input validations have passed with no errors (INPUT-OK is true, meaning neither account filter nor card filter has a validation error)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being finalized after all validation checks
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor length attribute for the account ID filter field (ACCTSIDL) is set to -1, which positions the cursor at the account ID filter field as the default entry point for the user

sub_functionalities.title: Determine Account ID Filter Display Value
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Determine Account ID\nFilter Display Value])
    B{Evaluate Account\nFilter State}
    C{Is Account Filter\nValid OR Has Error?}
    D[Display the entered\nAccount ID value\nin the filter field\nMake field enterable]
    E{Is Session\nAccount ID = Zero?}

    B --> C
    C -->|Yes - Filter is Valid\nOR Filter has Error| D

rules.rule_name: Skip Account Filter Display on First Entry or Menu Navigation
rules.rule_description: When the screen is being displayed for the very first time or when the user has navigated from the main menu, the account filter field display logic is bypassed entirely and no filter value population or attribute setting is performed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Determine Account ID Filter Display Value

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is accessing the Card List screen either for the first time in a new session (no prior session data exists) OR the user has just navigated from the main menu program into the Card List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Account ID filter field for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system skips all account filter field value population and attribute setting logic entirely; the account filter field is left in its default initialized state without any value or enterable attribute being explicitly set

rules.rule_name: Display Entered Account ID When Filter Is Valid
rules.rule_description: When the account filter value entered by the user has passed numeric validation successfully, the system redisplays the exact value the user typed into the account filter field and makes the field available for editing on the next interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account Filter Valid OR Has Error? → Yes - Filter is Valid OR Filter has Error → Display the entered Account ID value in the filter field / Make field enterable

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered a value in the Account ID filter field on the Card List screen AND the entered value has been validated and confirmed as a valid numeric account identifier
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Account ID filter field for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the Account ID filter field on screen with the exact account ID value that was entered by the user (CC-ACCT-ID) AND sets the field attribute to enterable so the user can modify it on the next screen interaction

rules.rule_name: Retain and Display Entered Account ID When Filter Has Validation Error
rules.rule_description: When the account filter value entered by the user has failed validation (e.g., non-numeric value), the system still redisplays the invalid value the user typed so they can see and correct it, and keeps the field editable.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account Filter Valid OR Has Error? → Yes - Filter is Valid OR Filter has Error → Display the entered Account ID value in the filter field / Make field enterable

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered a value in the Account ID filter field on the Card List screen AND the entered value has failed validation because it is not a valid numeric account identifier (filter error state is active)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Account ID filter field for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the Account ID filter field on screen with the exact invalid account ID value that was entered by the user (CC-ACCT-ID) AND sets the field attribute to enterable so the user can correct the value on the next screen interaction

rules.rule_name: Highlight Account ID Filter Field in Red When Validation Error Exists
rules.rule_description: When the account filter value has failed validation, the system visually highlights the Account ID filter field in red and positions the cursor to it, drawing the user's attention to the field that requires correction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account Filter Valid OR Has Error? → Yes - Filter is Valid OR Filter has Error → Display the entered Account ID value in the filter field / Make field enterable

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered a value in the Account ID filter field on the Card List screen AND the entered value has failed validation (filter error state is active indicating the account filter is not acceptable)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Account ID filter field display attributes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the Account ID filter field color to red to visually indicate an error AND positions the cursor to the Account ID filter field so the user's attention is directed to the field requiring correction

rules.rule_name: Clear Account ID Filter Field When No Account Filter Is Applied
rules.rule_description: When no account filter has been applied in the current session (the session account ID value is zero, meaning the user left the filter blank or cleared it), the system displays the account filter field as empty/blank.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Session Account ID = Zero? → Yes - Account ID is Zero / No filter applied → Clear the Account ID filter field / Field remains blank

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Card List screen AND no account ID filter has been applied in the current session, meaning the session-stored account ID value is zero (indicating the user did not supply an account filter)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Account ID filter field for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears the Account ID filter field on screen, leaving it blank with no value displayed, so the user sees an empty filter field indicating no account filter is currently active

rules.rule_name: Display Previously Saved Account ID From Session When Prior Filter Value Exists
rules.rule_description: When the session contains a previously saved account ID value that is non-zero and the filter is not in a current validation state, the system restores and displays that saved account ID value in the filter field and makes it editable, allowing the user to see and optionally modify the filter from their prior interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Session Account ID = Zero? → No - Other Condition / Prior session value exists → Display the previously saved Account ID value in the filter field / Make field enterable

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Card List screen AND the session contains a previously saved account ID value that is non-zero (a prior account filter was used in a previous interaction) AND the account filter is not currently in a validated or error state from the current submission
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Account ID filter field for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the Account ID filter field on screen with the previously saved session account ID value (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) AND sets the field attribute to enterable so the user can view and optionally modify the previously used account filter value

rules.rule_name: Display Entered Card Number When Card Filter Passes Validation
rules.rule_description: When the card number filter entered by the user has passed validation, the card filter display field should show the entered card number value and remain editable so the user can modify it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Card Filter Is Valid
Display the entered card number
in the card filter field
Make field enterable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and has entered a card number in the card filter field, and the card number filter has been validated successfully (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the card filter field for screen display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card filter display field (CARDSIDO) is populated with the entered card number value (CC-CARD-NUM), and the card filter field attribute is set to enterable/unprotected (DFHBMFSE) so the user can edit it

rules.rule_name: Display Entered Card Number When Card Filter Has a Validation Error
rules.rule_description: When the card number filter entered by the user has failed validation, the card filter display field should still retain and show the originally entered card number value and remain editable so the user can correct it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Card Filter Has Error
Display the entered card number
in the card filter field
Make field enterable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and has entered a card number in the card filter field, and the card number filter has failed validation (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the card filter field for screen display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card filter display field (CARDSIDO) is populated with the originally entered card number value (CC-CARD-NUM) so the user can see and correct their input, and the card filter field attribute is set to enterable/unprotected (DFHBMFSE) so the user can edit it

rules.rule_name: Clear Card Number Filter Field When No Card Number Exists in Session
rules.rule_description: When no card number has been stored in the current session (session card number is zero), the card filter display field should be cleared and left blank, indicating no active card filter is in effect.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Session Card Number Is Zero
Clear the card filter field
Leave field blank

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and no card number filter has been entered or saved in the session (CDEMO-CARD-NUM equals zero), and the card filter is neither in a valid nor error state
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the card filter field for screen display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card filter display field (CARDSIDO) is cleared to LOW-VALUES (blank), leaving the field empty with no card number displayed and no enterable attribute set

rules.rule_name: Display Session Card Number in Filter Field When Card Number Exists in Session
rules.rule_description: When a card number exists in the session (non-zero) but the filter is not in a specific valid or error state, the card filter display field should show the session-stored card number and remain editable so the user can modify or clear it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
All Other Conditions
Display the saved session
card number in the filter field
Make field enterable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and a card number is stored in the session (CDEMO-CARD-NUM is non-zero), and the card filter state does not match valid (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID), error (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), or zero session card number conditions
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the card filter field for screen display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card filter display field (CARDSIDO) is populated with the session-stored card number value (CDEMO-CARD-NUM), and the card filter field attribute is set to enterable/unprotected (DFHBMFSE) so the user can edit it

rules.rule_name: Preserve Existing Filter Error Message Without Override
rules.rule_description: When account or card filter validation errors exist, the system preserves the existing filter error message and does not replace it with any navigation or informational message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account or Card Filter Has Errors? → Keep Existing Error Message No Change

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and has submitted the screen with filter values
acceptance_criteria.When: Either the Account ID filter or the Card Number filter has a validation error (invalid non-numeric value entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The existing filter error message is retained unchanged; no navigation message or informational action message is set; the error message is displayed on screen as-is

rules.rule_name: Display No Previous Pages Message When Navigating Before First Page
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate to a previous page while already on the first page of the card list, the system informs them that no earlier pages are available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: PF7 Pressed AND Currently on First Page? → Set Error Message: 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen and is currently on the first page of results
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF7 (Previous Page) to navigate backward
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error message is set to 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY' and this message is displayed on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display No More Pages Message When Last Page Was Already Shown
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate forward past the last page of the card list, and the last page has already been displayed in a prior navigation, the system informs them that no further pages exist.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: PF8 Pressed AND No Next Page AND Last Page Already Shown? → Set Error Message: 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen, there are no more card records beyond the current page, and the last page has already been shown to the user in a previous interaction
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 (Next Page) to navigate forward
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error message is set to 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' and this message is displayed on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Action Instructions When Reaching Last Page for the First Time
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates forward and reaches the last page of card records for the first time, the system displays action instructions and marks the last page as having been shown so subsequent PF8 presses produce a different message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: PF8 Pressed AND No Next Page Exists? → Set Message: 'TYPE S FOR DETAIL, U TO UPDATE' → Was Last Page Not Yet Shown? → Mark Last Page as Now Shown

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen and there are no more card records beyond the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 (Next Page) and this is the first time the last page is being reached (last page has not yet been marked as shown)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to action instructions (guiding the user to type S for card detail or U to update); the last page status is marked as 'now shown' so that a subsequent PF8 press will display 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' instead

rules.rule_name: Display Action Instructions When Records Are Available and More Pages Exist
rules.rule_description: When card records are displayed on screen and either no informational message has been set yet or additional pages of records exist, the system displays action instructions to guide the user on how to interact with the listed cards.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Info Message Set OR Next Page Exists? → Set Message: 'TYPE S FOR DETAIL, U TO UPDATE'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen with card records displayed, and no filter errors or navigation boundary errors have been triggered
acceptance_criteria.When: Either no informational message has been set for the current display, or there are additional pages of card records available beyond the current page
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to action instructions guiding the user to type S to view card detail or U to update a card

rules.rule_name: Clear Informational Message When No Applicable Condition Is Met
rules.rule_description: When none of the specific message conditions apply (no filter errors, no navigation boundary reached, no next page indicator, and no active informational message), the system clears the informational message area so no misleading message is shown.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Info Message Set OR Next Page Exists? → No → Clear Info Message No Message to Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen and none of the specific message trigger conditions are active (no filter errors, not on first page with PF7, not at last page with PF8, no next page flag, and no existing info message)
acceptance_criteria.When: The message setup process evaluates all conditions and none match the defined scenarios
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is cleared and no informational message is displayed on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Error Message on Screen
rules.rule_description: After all message conditions have been evaluated and the appropriate error message has been determined, the system places the error message into the screen output area for display to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message on Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The message setup process has completed evaluating all conditions and an error message value has been set (either from filter validation, navigation boundary, or retained from prior state)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error message content is moved to the screen error message display field (ERRMSGO) so it is visible to the user on the Card List screen

rules.rule_name: Display Informational Action Message in Neutral Color When Records Found
rules.rule_description: When an informational action message has been set and records have been found (not a no-records-found condition), the system displays the informational message in a neutral (non-error) color to distinguish it from error messages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Records Found AND Info Message Active? → Display Info Message in Neutral Color

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card List screen is being prepared for display with card records present
acceptance_criteria.When: An informational message is active (not in the 'no info message' state) AND the screen is not in a 'no records found' state
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message text is moved to the screen informational message display field (INFOMSGO) and the message color attribute is set to neutral (non-highlighted, non-error color) so the user can distinguish it from error messages

sub_functionalities.title: Set Error Message: 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY'

    B{Was PF8\nPage Down\nPressed?}

    E[Set Error Message:\n'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY']
    F([Continue to Next\nMessage Check])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - PF8 Pressed| C
    B -->|No| F

    C -->|No - Next Page Exists| F

rules.rule_name: Display 'No More Pages' Error When User Attempts to Navigate Beyond Last Page
rules.rule_description: When a user presses the Page Down key (PF8) to navigate forward in the card list, but there are no more pages of records available AND the last page has already been displayed to the user in a prior navigation step, the system must inform the user that no additional pages exist by displaying the error message 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY'.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' - Determine if PF8 was pressed, next page does not exist, AND last page was already shown previously, then set the no more pages error message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen and has previously navigated to and viewed the last available page of card records (last page already shown flag is set), and no further pages of card records exist beyond the currently displayed page
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the Page Down key (PF8) to attempt to navigate to the next page of card records
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error message to 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' and redisplays the Card List screen with this error message, indicating to the user that there are no additional pages of card records to navigate to

sub_functionalities.title: Set Message: 'TYPE S FOR DETAIL, U TO UPDATE' and Mark Last Page as Now Shown
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Enter Message Setup\nfor PF8 Pressed])
    B{Next Page\nExists?}
    C([Exit - Other\nMessage Handling])
    D[Set Message:\n'TYPE S FOR DETAIL,\nU TO UPDATE']
    E{Has Last Page\nAlready Been Shown?}
    F[Mark Last Page\nas Now Shown]
    G([Exit Message\nSetup])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - More Pages Exist| C
    B -->|No - No Next Page Exists| D
    D --> E
    E -->|No - Last Page\nNot Yet Shown| F
    F --> G
    E -->|Yes - Last Page\nAlready Shown| G

rules.rule_name: Display Action Instructions When Last Page Reached via PF8
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 (Next Page) and there are no further pages of card records available, the system displays action instruction message guiding the user on how to interact with the displayed card records — specifically to enter 'S' to view card detail or 'U' to update a card.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Message: 'TYPE S FOR DETAIL, U TO UPDATE'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen and has navigated to a page where no additional pages of card records exist beyond the currently displayed page
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 (Next Page) and the system determines that no next page of card records exists
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the informational message to 'TYPE S FOR DETAIL, U TO UPDATE' to instruct the user on available row-level actions for the displayed card records

rules.rule_name: Mark Last Page as Shown When First Reached via PF8
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 and reaches the last page of card records for the first time, the system updates the last-page-shown indicator so that subsequent PF8 presses can correctly display the 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' message instead of repeating the action instructions message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Last Page as Now Shown

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen, has pressed PF8, no next page of card records exists, and the last page has NOT yet been previously shown to the user (last-page-not-shown indicator is active)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the PF8 action and confirms that no next page exists and the last page has not yet been shown
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the last page indicator as 'now shown' (sets CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN to TRUE), so that any subsequent PF8 press will trigger the 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' message instead of the action instructions message

rules.rule_name: Suppress Last Page Shown Update When Last Page Already Displayed
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 and the last page has already been shown in a prior interaction, the system does not update the last-page-shown indicator again. This preserves the state so that the correct 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' message continues to be shown on further PF8 presses.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Has Last Page Already Been Shown?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen, has pressed PF8, no next page of card records exists, and the last page HAS already been shown to the user in a previous interaction (CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is already TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the last page shown indicator needs to be updated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system does NOT update the last-page-shown indicator and exits message setup without any change to the last-page state, allowing the 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' message to be triggered on the next PF8 press

rules.rule_name: Prepare and Transmit Fully Populated Credit Card List Screen
rules.rule_description: Before transmitting the screen to the user, the system must complete all screen preparation steps in sequence: initialize screen header fields, populate card data rows, set field attributes, configure filter field attributes, and set informational or error messages. Only after all preparation steps are complete is the screen transmitted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Prepare Credit Card List Screen
for Transmission to Terminal

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is ready to display the credit card list screen to the user, and all card data rows, filter values, field attributes, and messages have been assembled into the screen output area (CCRDLIAO)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates the screen transmission sequence by executing all preparation steps: screen header initialization, card data row population, row field attribute setup, filter field attribute setup, and message setup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system transmits the fully populated credit card list screen to the user's terminal using the designated map (LIT-THISMAP) and mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET), ensuring all header information, card records, field attributes, and messages are included in the transmission

rules.rule_name: Send Credit Card List Screen with Cursor Positioned at Appropriate Field
rules.rule_description: When transmitting the credit card list screen, the system must position the cursor at the field designated during screen attribute setup (e.g., the first invalid field, the account filter field, or the first available selection field), so the user's attention is directed to the most relevant input area.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Send Screen to User Terminal
with Cursor Positioned
at Appropriate Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card list screen output area (CCRDLIAO) is fully populated with card data, header information, field attributes, and messages, and the cursor position has been set during screen attribute setup (e.g., ACCTSIDL set to -1 for account filter field, or CARDSIDL set to -1 for card filter field, or a selection field length set to -1 for an error row)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the screen to the user's terminal using the CICS SEND MAP command with the CURSOR option
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is transmitted with the cursor automatically positioned at the field whose length attribute was set to -1 during attribute setup, directing the user to the appropriate input field (invalid filter field, error selection field, or default entry field)

rules.rule_name: Erase Previous Screen Content on Transmission
rules.rule_description: Each time the credit card list screen is sent to the user's terminal, the previous screen content must be completely erased so the user sees a clean, fully refreshed display. This prevents residual data from a prior screen from being visible alongside the new screen content.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Erase Previous Screen Content
so User Sees Fresh Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user's terminal currently displays a previous version of the credit card list screen or any other prior screen content
acceptance_criteria.When: The system transmits the updated credit card list screen to the terminal using the CICS SEND MAP command with the ERASE option
acceptance_criteria.Then: All previous screen content on the user's terminal is completely cleared before the new credit card list screen is rendered, ensuring the user sees only the current, fully refreshed screen data

rules.rule_name: Unlock User Keyboard After Screen Transmission
rules.rule_description: After the credit card list screen has been transmitted to the user's terminal, the keyboard must be unlocked (freed) so the user can immediately begin entering input such as filter values, row selections, or function key commands. The keyboard remains locked during screen transmission to prevent premature input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Unlock Keyboard
so User Can Enter Input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card list screen has been successfully transmitted to the user's terminal and the keyboard is currently locked during the transmission process
acceptance_criteria.When: The CICS SEND MAP command completes the screen transmission with the FREEKB option specified
acceptance_criteria.Then: The user's keyboard is unlocked and made available for input, allowing the user to enter account filter values, card number filter values, row selection codes (S or U), or press function keys (ENTER, PF3, PF7, PF8) to interact with the displayed credit card list

rules.rule_name: Await User Response After Screen Transmission Complete
rules.rule_description: After the credit card list screen has been transmitted, the keyboard unlocked, and the screen erased and refreshed, the system returns control to CICS with the current transaction ID and the full communication area, suspending processing until the user submits a response. The session state (page position, filter values, bookmarks) is preserved in the communication area for the next interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Screen Transmission Complete
Awaiting User Response

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card list screen has been fully transmitted to the user's terminal with the cursor positioned, previous content erased, and keyboard unlocked, and the system has completed all screen preparation and transmission steps
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the COMMON-RETURN routine after screen transmission, saving the current communication area (including transaction ID set to LIT-THISTRANID, program name set to LIT-THISPGM, last mapset set to LIT-THISMAPSET, last map set to LIT-THISMAP, and the full program communication area including page number, first card bookmark, last card bookmark, and page state flags) into the return communication area
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is returned to CICS with the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) and the preserved communication area (WS-COMMAREA containing both CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA), and the system waits for the user to submit a new request before resuming processing

rules.rule_name: Account Filter Treated as Not Applied When Blank or Zero
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID search filter field is left blank, contains only spaces, or is entered as zero, the system treats this as the user not wishing to filter by account, clears any previously stored account filter value, and proceeds without restricting card records by account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
No Filter Applied
Clear Account ID filter
Treat as no filter condition

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Card List screen and the Account ID filter field is available for input
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen with the Account ID filter field left blank (empty), containing only spaces, or entered as zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system treats the account filter as not applied, clears the stored Account ID filter value to zero, sets the account filter status to 'blank/no filter', and continues processing without restricting card records by account ID

rules.rule_name: Account Filter Rejected When Non-Numeric Characters Entered
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID filter field contains a value that includes non-numeric characters, the system rejects the input, marks the overall input state as invalid, clears the account filter value, and prevents the user from selecting any card rows until the error is corrected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark Input as Error
Protect all card selection rows
Set error message:
'ACCOUNT FILTER, IF SUPPLIED
MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'
Clear Account ID value

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Card List screen and has entered a value in the Account ID filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered Account ID filter value contains one or more non-numeric characters (i.e., is not a purely numeric value)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system: (1) marks the overall input state as an error, (2) marks the account filter status as invalid/not-OK, (3) sets the error message to 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER', (4) clears the stored Account ID filter value to zero, and (5) protects all card selection rows so no card row action can be selected while the error exists

rules.rule_name: Account Filter Error Field Highlighted in Red with Cursor Positioned
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID filter field has been flagged as invalid, the system visually highlights the Account ID field in red on the screen and positions the cursor to that field to direct the user's attention to the error requiring correction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark Input as Error
Protect all card selection rows
Set error message:
'ACCOUNT FILTER, IF SUPPLIED
MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'
Clear Account ID value

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account ID filter field has been validated and found to contain an invalid (non-numeric) value
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card List screen is being prepared for display after an account filter validation error
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the Account ID filter field highlighted in red and positions the screen cursor directly to the Account ID filter field so the user can immediately correct the invalid entry

rules.rule_name: All Card Selection Rows Protected When Account Filter Is Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID filter validation fails, all seven card row selection fields on the screen are made non-enterable (protected), preventing the user from attempting to view or update any card while the filter input error exists.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark Input as Error
Protect all card selection rows
Set error message:
'ACCOUNT FILTER, IF SUPPLIED
MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'
Clear Account ID value

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account ID filter field has been validated and found to contain an invalid (non-numeric) value, setting the 'protect selection rows' flag to active
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card List screen is being prepared for display with the account filter error condition active
acceptance_criteria.Then: All seven card row selection fields (rows 1 through 7) are set to protected/non-enterable mode regardless of whether those rows contain card data, preventing any view or update action on any card row until the account filter error is resolved

rules.rule_name: Valid Numeric Account Filter Accepted and Stored as Active Filter
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID filter field contains a value that is entirely numeric, the system accepts it as a valid account filter, stores it as the active account filter for restricting the card list, and marks the account filter status as valid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Accept as Valid Filter
Store Account ID as
Active Account Filter

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Card List screen and has entered a value in the Account ID filter field that is not blank, not spaces, and not zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered Account ID filter value consists entirely of numeric digits (passes numeric validation)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system accepts the value as a valid account filter, stores the entered Account ID as the active account filter value to be used when reading card records, and sets the account filter status to 'valid/active', enabling filtering of the card list to show only cards belonging to the specified account

rules.rule_name: Blank or Zero Card Number Treated as No Filter
rules.rule_description: When the card number search field is left empty or contains only zeros, the system treats this as the user not wishing to filter by card number. No card number filter is applied, and the card number filter status is set to blank so all cards remain eligible for display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
No Filter Applied
Clear card number filter
Set filter status to Blank

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Card List screen and has submitted the screen with the card number filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The card number filter field is blank (empty or spaces) OR contains a zero value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the card number filter status to 'Blank' (no filter active), clears the card number filter value to zero, and proceeds without applying any card number restriction to the card list results

rules.rule_name: Non-Numeric Card Number Filter Rejected with Validation Error
rules.rule_description: When a user enters a card number filter value that contains non-numeric characters, the system rejects the input, flags it as an error, prevents any card row from being selected, and clears the card number filter. This enforces that the card number filter must be a valid 16-digit numeric value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Reject Input
Set Error: Card ID Filter if supplied
must be a 16-digit number
Protect all card selection rows
Clear card number filter

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Card List screen and has submitted the screen with a non-blank, non-zero value in the card number filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered card number filter value is not numeric (contains letters, special characters, or other non-numeric content)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system: (1) sets the overall input status to 'Error', (2) sets the card number filter status to 'Not OK' (invalid), (3) protects all card selection rows so no card can be selected, (4) clears the card number filter value to zero, and (5) if no prior error message has already been set, displays the error message: 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'

rules.rule_name: Card Number Filter Error Message Set Only When No Prior Error Exists
rules.rule_description: When a non-numeric card number filter triggers an error, the specific card filter error message is only written if no other error message has already been recorded during the current validation cycle. This ensures the first error encountered takes precedence and is not overwritten by subsequent validation errors.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Reject Input
Set Error: Card ID Filter if supplied
must be a 16-digit number
Protect all card selection rows
Clear card number filter

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card number filter has been determined to be non-numeric and an error condition is being raised
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to set the card number filter error message 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error message is only set if no prior error message has already been recorded (i.e., the error message field is currently in its 'off' or empty state); if a prior error message already exists, the card filter error message is NOT written and the existing error message is preserved

rules.rule_name: Valid Numeric Card Number Accepted as Active Card Filter
rules.rule_description: When a user enters a card number filter value that is numeric and non-zero, the system accepts it as a valid active filter. The numeric card number value is stored as the active card filter, and the filter status is marked as valid so that subsequent card list reads will restrict results to only cards matching this card number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Accept Card Number Filter
Store as active card filter
Set filter status to Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Card List screen and has submitted the screen with a non-blank, non-zero value in the card number filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered card number filter value is numeric
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the numeric card number value as the active card number filter, sets the card number filter status to 'Valid', and the card list will subsequently be filtered to display only cards whose card number matches the entered value
