all_rules.Rule_Description: When re-displaying the first page after a PF7 press on the first page, the system retrieves the saved first card number bookmark from the current session state to use as the starting point for the forward read.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card file read position has been set to the First Card Number bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM), and the display row counter is initialised to zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a sequential forward read of the card file starting at or after the first card key (using GTEQ positioning)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads records one by one and collects up to a maximum of 7 matching credit card records; reading stops when 7 records have been collected or the end of the card file is reached

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Forward Up to 7 Card Records from First Card Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: Starting from the first card key bookmark, the system reads forward through the card file and collects up to a maximum of 7 credit card records to populate the display page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A forward read of the card file is in progress and the user has entered a valid numeric Account ID filter (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Each card record is read from the file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system compares the card record's Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) against the user-supplied Account ID filter value (CC-ACCT-ID); if they match the record is included for display, and if they do not match the record is excluded and skipped silently

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Account ID Filter During Forward Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: During the forward read of card records, if the user has supplied a valid Account ID filter, only records whose account ID matches the filter value are included in the results; all others are skipped.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A forward read of the card file is in progress and the user has entered a valid numeric Card Number filter (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Each card record is read from the file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system compares the card record's Card Number (CARD-NUM) against the user-supplied Card Number filter value (CC-CARD-NUM-N); if they match the record is included for display, and if they do not match the record is excluded and skipped silently

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Card Number Filter During Forward Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: During the forward read of card records, if the user has supplied a valid Card Number filter, only records whose card number matches the filter value are included in the results; all others are skipped.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been read from the file and has passed all active filter checks (account ID filter and card number filter where applicable)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The record is confirmed as not excluded (WS-DONOT-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system increments the display row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) by 1 and stores the following data into the corresponding display row: Card Number (CARD-NUM) into WS-ROW-CARD-NUM, Account Number (CARD-ACCT-ID) into WS-ROW-ACCTNO, and Card Active Status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) into WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS for that row position

all_rules.Rule_Name: Collect Matching Card Record Data for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each card record that passes all active filters, the system collects the Account Number, Card Number, and Card Active Status and stores them in the corresponding display row slot for screen population.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 (Page Up) and the current page is the first page (CA-FIRST-PAGE is TRUE), and neither the Account ID filter nor the Card Number filter is in an invalid state
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the message area for screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error message field (WS-ERROR-MSG) to 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY', which will be shown to the user on the redisplayed screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Advisory Message for Page Up on First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF7 while already on the first page, the system sets an advisory error message to inform the user that there are no previous pages available to navigate to.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The forward read from the first card key has completed, up to 7 matching card records have been collected, and the advisory message 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY' has been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system builds and sends the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates the screen with: (1) screen header fields including current date, current time, transaction ID, program name, and current page number; (2) up to 7 card data rows each showing Account Number, Card Number, and Card Active Status; (3) selection fields set as editable for rows with data and protected for empty rows; (4) the advisory error message 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY' in the error message area; and (5) the completed screen is sent to the user with the keyboard unlocked and the previous screen erased

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Screen with First Page Card Results
all_rules.Rule_Description: After re-reading the first page records and setting the advisory message, the system populates all screen fields including card data rows, filter fields, screen header information, and field attributes, then sends the completed screen to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing a page of credit card records on the Card List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 (Page Down)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the next-page-available indicator is set to TRUE, the system proceeds with forward navigation to the next page; if the next-page-available indicator is FALSE (no more pages exist), the system keeps the user on the current page without any navigation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Verify Next Page Availability Before Page Down Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before navigating to the next page, the system must verify that a next page of card records actually exists. If no next page is available, the user remains on the current page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 and a next page of card records is confirmed to exist, and the current page has a recorded last card number bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to read the next page of card records
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the card file read starting position (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) to the value of the last card number from the current page (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM), so that the forward read begins from the record immediately following the last displayed card

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Starting Position for Next Page Read Using Last Card Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: When navigating forward to the next page, the system uses the last card number displayed on the current page as the starting key to read the next set of records from the card file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8, a next page exists, and the system is preparing to display the next page of card records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system advances to the next page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen/page number counter (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is incremented by exactly 1, and this updated page number is displayed in the screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Page Number When Navigating to Next Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time the user successfully navigates to the next page, the current page number counter is incremented by 1 to reflect the new page being displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is preparing to display a new page of card records after a PF8 navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The forward read process (9000-READ-FORWARD) is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All 7 card display rows (WS-ALL-ROWS, which encompasses WS-ROW-CARD-NUM, WS-ROW-ACCTNO, and WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS for rows 1 through 7) are reset to LOW-VALUES before any new records are loaded

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Card Display Rows Before Loading New Page Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating the screen with the next page of card records, all 7 card display rows must be cleared to prevent stale data from the previous page from appearing on the new page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The starting card key position has been set to the last card number from the previous page (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM), and all display rows have been cleared
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system begins reading card records for the new page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card file browse is initiated at the position greater than or equal to the specified card key (GTEQ), and the screen counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is initialized to zero, and the next-page-exists indicator is set to TRUE as a default before reading begins

all_rules.Rule_Name: Start Browsing Card File Forward from Last Card Key Position
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system initiates a forward browse of the card file starting at or after the specified card key position, using a greater-than-or-equal (GTEQ) positioning strategy to locate the correct starting record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account ID filter flag (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID) is active, indicating the user has entered a valid account ID filter value (CC-ACCT-ID)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Each card record is read from the card file during the forward browse
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the card record's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) exactly equals the filter account ID (CC-ACCT-ID), the record is included for display; if the card record's account ID does not match, the record is excluded (WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is set) and the system moves on to read the next record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Filter Card Records by Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an account ID filter has been entered and validated by the user, only card records whose account ID exactly matches the filter value are included in the page display; all non-matching records are excluded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card number filter flag (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID) is active, indicating the user has entered a valid card number filter value (CC-CARD-NUM-N), and the record has already passed the account ID filter check (if applicable)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Each card record is evaluated during the forward browse
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the card record's card number (CARD-NUM) exactly equals the filter card number (CC-CARD-NUM-N), the record is included for display; if the card number does not match, the record is excluded (WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is set) and the system moves on to read the next record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Filter Card Records by Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card number filter has been entered and validated by the user, only card records whose card number exactly matches the filter value are included in the page display; all non-matching records are excluded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been read from the card file and one or more search filters are active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The record fails to match the active account ID filter or the active card number filter
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The record is excluded from the display (WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD indicator is set), the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is NOT incremented, and the system immediately reads the next card record without adding any data to the display rows

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Records That Do Not Match Active Search Filters
all_rules.Rule_Description: Card records that do not satisfy the active search filter criteria (account ID and/or card number) are silently skipped and not counted toward the page display limit, ensuring only matching records are shown to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been read from the card file and has passed all active search filters (WS-DONOT-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The record is confirmed to be included in the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is incremented by 1, and the card number (CARD-NUM) is stored in WS-ROW-CARD-NUM at the current counter position, the account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is stored in WS-ROW-ACCTNO at the current counter position, and the card active status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) is stored in WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS at the current counter position

all_rules.Rule_Name: Add Matching Card Record to the Current Page Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each card record that passes all active search filters is added to the next available display row on the current page, storing the card number, account ID, and card active status.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has passed all filters and is being added to the display, and the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) has just been incremented to 1 (meaning this is the first record on the new page)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first qualifying record is stored in display row 1
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is saved to WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-ACCT-ID and the card's card number (CARD-NUM) is saved to WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM as the first-card bookmark for this page; additionally, if the page counter (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is currently 0, it is incremented by 1 to set the page number to 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save First Card Key Bookmark When First Record Is Added to New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the very first qualifying card record is added to a new page, its card number and account ID are saved as the first-card bookmark for the page, enabling backward navigation (PF7) to return to this page later.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Card records are being read and added to the current page display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A card record is successfully added to the display and the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If WS-SCRN-COUNTER equals WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES (7), the page is considered full and the read loop is flagged to exit (READ-LOOP-EXIT set to TRUE); if WS-SCRN-COUNTER is less than 7, reading continues to fill the remaining rows

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect When Current Page Has Reached Maximum Display Capacity of 7 Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system continuously checks whether the current page has been filled to its maximum capacity of 7 card records after each record is added, to determine when to stop reading and check for additional pages.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The page has just been filled to its maximum capacity of 7 card records (WS-SCRN-COUNTER equals WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The read loop is flagged to exit after filling the page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current card's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is saved to WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and the current card's card number (CARD-NUM) is saved to WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM as the last-card bookmark for this page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Last Card Key Bookmark When Page Is Full
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the page reaches its maximum of 7 records, the card number and account ID of the last displayed record are saved as the last-card bookmark, which will serve as the starting point for the next page-down navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current page has been filled with exactly 7 card records and the last-card bookmark has been saved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a peek read of the next record in the card file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the peek read returns a record successfully (normal or duplicate record response), the next-page-available indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) is set to TRUE and the peeked record's account ID and card number are updated into WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM; if the peek read reaches end of file, the no-more-pages indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) is set to TRUE and the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set (if no prior error message exists)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Peek at Next Record to Determine If Another Page Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: After filling a page with 7 records, the system attempts to read one additional record from the card file to determine whether more records exist beyond the current page, which controls whether the PF8 (Page Down) option will be available to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current page is full with 7 records and a peek read of the next record has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The peek read successfully retrieves a record (normal or duplicate record response)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next-page-available indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) is set to TRUE, and the peeked record's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is stored in WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and the peeked record's card number (CARD-NUM) is stored in WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Next Page as Available After Successful Peek Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the peek read confirms that additional card records exist beyond the current page, the system marks the next-page indicator as available so that the user can continue navigating forward with PF8.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current page is full with 7 records and a peek read of the next record has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The peek read reaches the end of the card file (end-of-file condition)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The no-more-pages indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) is set to TRUE, and if no prior error message has been set (WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF is TRUE), the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is placed in WS-ERROR-MSG

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark No More Pages Available When Peek Read Reaches End of File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the peek read after filling a page confirms that no more records exist in the card file, the system marks the current page as the last page, preventing further forward navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is reading card records forward to fill the current page and has not yet reached 7 records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The end of the card file is encountered during a READNEXT operation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The read loop is flagged to exit (READ-LOOP-EXIT set to TRUE), the no-more-pages indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) is set to TRUE, the last card's account ID and card number are saved to WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM, and if no prior error message exists the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set; additionally, if this is page 1 (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM = 1) and zero records were found (WS-SCRN-COUNTER = 0), the no-records-found indicator (WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND) is set to TRUE

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark No More Pages When End of Card File Is Reached During Normal Reading
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card file reaches its end during normal forward reading (before filling 7 rows), the system marks the current page as the last page, stops reading, and if no records were found on the first page, sets a no-records-found indicator.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed reading card records for the new page and is preparing to display the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen initialization process (1100-SCREEN-INIT) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen output area (CCRDLIAO) is cleared to LOW-VALUES, and the following fields are populated: screen title line 1 (TITLE01O) from CCDA-TITLE01, screen title line 2 (TITLE02O) from CCDA-TITLE02, transaction ID (TRNNAMEO) from LIT-THISTRANID, program name (PGMNAMEO) from LIT-THISPGM, current date in MM/DD/YY format (CURDATEO), current time in HH:MM:SS format (CURTIMEO), and the current page number (PAGENOO) from WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM

all_rules.Rule_Name: Build Screen Header with Current Date, Time, and Page Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before sending the updated screen to the user, the system populates the screen header with standard information including screen titles, transaction ID, program name, current date, current time, and the updated page number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen header has been initialized and card records have been loaded into the work storage rows (WS-EACH-CARD 1 through 7)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen array initialization process (1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For each of the 7 possible rows (1 through 7): if the row's data (WS-EACH-CARD) is equal to LOW-VALUES (empty), the row is left blank on screen; if the row contains data, the selection field (CRDSELnO), account number (ACCTNOnO), card number (CRDNUMnO), and card active status (CRDSTSnO) are populated from WS-EDIT-SELECT(n), WS-ROW-ACCTNO(n), WS-ROW-CARD-NUM(n), and WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS(n) respectively

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Up to 7 Card Display Rows with Card Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen is populated with card data for each of the up to 7 rows, displaying the selection field, account number, card number, and card active status for each row that contains data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen card rows have been populated with available card data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row display attributes setup process (1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS) is executed for each of the 7 rows
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For each row (1 through 7): if the row is empty (WS-EACH-CARD equals LOW-VALUES) OR the global protect-rows flag (FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES) is active, the row's selection field attribute is set to protected (DFHBMPRF for row 1, DFHBMPRO for rows 2-7); if the row contains data AND protect-rows is not active, the selection field is set to enterable (DFHBMFSE); additionally, if a row has a selection error flag set to '1', the selection field color is set to red (DFHRED) and if the selection value is blank or LOW-VALUES for row 1, an asterisk '*' is displayed in the selection field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Row Selection Field Attributes Based on Data Availability and Protection Status
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each card row's selection field is set to either enterable (allowing the user to type 'S' or 'U') or protected (read-only) based on whether the row contains card data and whether the selection rows are globally protected due to a filter validation error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen has been populated with card records and the system is finalizing the display for a PF8 page-down action
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The message setup process (1400-SETUP-MESSAGE) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following message logic applies in priority order: (1) if account or card filter is invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK or FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), no informational message is set and processing continues; (2) if PF8 was pressed and no next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) and the last page was already shown (CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN), the error message 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY' is set in WS-ERROR-MSG; (3) if PF8 was pressed and no next page exists and the last page has NOT yet been shown (CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN), the informational action message (WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS) is set and CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is set to TRUE; (4) if no info message condition or next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS), the informational action message is set; the final error message (WS-ERROR-MSG) is moved to ERRMSGO and if an informational message is active and no-records-found is not set, the info message (WS-INFO-MSG) is moved to INFOMSGO with neutral color (DFHNEUTR)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Navigation and Informational Messages Based on Page Position and Indicators
all_rules.Rule_Description: After reading records and building the screen, the system determines and sets the appropriate informational or error message to guide the user, based on the current page position, filter status, and whether more pages exist.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen has been fully prepared with card data, row attributes, header information, and navigation messages
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen send process (1500-SEND-SCREEN) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen map (LIT-THISMAP) from the mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET) is sent to the user terminal using the prepared output data (CCRDLIAO), the previous screen content is erased (ERASE), the cursor is positioned at the designated field (CURSOR), and the keyboard is unlocked (FREEKB) so the user can interact with the new page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Send Updated Card List Screen to User Terminal
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all screen data, attributes, and messages have been prepared, the completed screen is transmitted to the user's terminal, erasing the previous screen content and displaying the new page of card records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the last page of card records and the next-page-available indicator (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) is FALSE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 (Page Down)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The EVALUATE routing does not match the 'CCARD-AID-PFK08 AND CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS' condition, the system falls through to the default (WHEN OTHER) processing which performs a forward read from the first card bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM) and redisplays the current page; the page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is NOT incremented

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retain Current Page When No Next Page Is Available on PF8
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF8 but no next page of records exists, the system does not navigate forward. Instead, it redisplays the current page, preserving the existing page state and displaying an appropriate message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Card List screen and the current page is NOT the first page (CA-FIRST-PAGE flag is not set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 (Page Up key)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system uses the first card number of the current page as the starting point, decrements the page number by 1, performs a backward read of the card file, and displays the previous page of card records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Backward Page Navigation on PF7 When Not on First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF7 (Page Up) and the current display is not the first page, the system initiates backward navigation to retrieve and display the previous page of card records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has triggered backward page navigation (PF7 on a non-first page)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to read the previous page of card records
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the card file record identifier (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) to the first card number of the current page (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM) to use as the starting position for the backward browse

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Starting Point for Backward Read Using Current First Card Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before initiating a backward read, the system sets the card file record identifier to the first card number of the currently displayed page, which serves as the anchor point for backward navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is processing a backward page navigation request
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backward read is initiated for the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen page number counter (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is decremented by 1 so the page number displayed to the user correctly reflects the previous page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Decrement Page Number When Navigating to Previous Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When navigating backward to the previous page, the system decrements the current screen/page number by 1 to reflect the correct page position in the display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is preparing to navigate to the previous page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backward read procedure (9100-READ-BACKWARDS) is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current first card key (WS-CA-FIRST-CARDKEY) is copied to the last card key reference (WS-CA-LAST-CARDKEY) to maintain accurate pagination bookmarks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Current First Card Key as Last Card Key Reference Before Backward Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before performing the backward read, the system copies the current page's first card key to the last card key reference field, preserving navigation bookmarks for future forward/backward navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has set the record identifier to the first card number of the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backward browse is initiated on the card file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system opens a browse session on the card file (LIT-CARD-FILE) positioned at the record matching or immediately following the current first card key (GTEQ positioning), ready for backward reading

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Backward Browse on Card File from Current First Card Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system opens a browse session on the card file starting at or after the current first card key position, using a greater-than-or-equal positioning strategy to anchor the backward read.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backward browse session has been successfully opened on the card file at the current first card key position
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs the initial positioning read
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads one record backward (READPREV) to skip past the current page's first record; if this initial skip read returns a normal or duplicate record response, the screen counter is set to MAX-SCREEN-LINES + 1 (i.e., 8) and the system proceeds to fill rows; if the read fails with any other response, an error is recorded and backward navigation is aborted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip One Record Backward to Position Before Current Page Start
all_rules.Rule_Description: After opening the backward browse, the system reads one record backward to move the file position to just before the start of the current page, so that subsequent backward reads retrieve records from the previous page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has opened a backward browse on the card file and is attempting the initial positioning skip read
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The initial READPREV returns an unexpected error response (not normal, not duplicate record, not end-of-file)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system records the operation name as 'READ', the file name, the response code, and the reason code into the error fields, sets the file error message as the error message to display, sets the read loop exit flag, and proceeds to close the browse session and display the error to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Skip Failure During Backward Positioning
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the initial backward skip read fails with an unexpected error, the system records the error details and terminates the backward read operation, displaying an error message to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The initial backward positioning skip has succeeded and the system is ready to populate the screen rows
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backward read loop begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) starts at WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES + 1 (value 8), and each successfully filtered record decrements this counter by 1 before being placed in the corresponding screen row, so that the first record read (oldest/previous) fills row 7 and subsequent records fill rows 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 in order

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Screen Row Fill from Bottom Row Upward
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system fills the screen display array from the bottom row (row 7) upward toward row 1, because records are being read in reverse order from the card file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backward read loop is active and more screen rows need to be filled
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the next record in the backward direction from the card file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system performs a READPREV operation on the card file (LIT-CARD-FILE) into the card record buffer, retrieving the card number, account ID, and active status fields for evaluation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Previous Record from Card File in Backward Loop
all_rules.Rule_Description: Within the backward read loop, the system continuously reads the previous record from the card file to retrieve card records in reverse order for display on the previous page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backward read loop is active and a READPREV operation has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The READPREV returns an unexpected error response (not normal, not duplicate record, not end-of-file)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system records the operation name as 'READ', the card file name, the response code, and the reason code into the error fields, sets the file error message as the error message, sets the read loop exit flag to terminate the loop, and proceeds to close the browse and display the error

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Read Error During Backward Loop
all_rules.Rule_Description: If an unexpected error occurs while reading a record during the backward loop, the system records the error details, exits the read loop, and proceeds to display an error message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully read from the card file during backward navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The filter evaluation is performed on the record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If an account ID filter is active (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID), the record's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) must equal the filter value (CC-ACCT-ID), otherwise the record is excluded; if a card number filter is active (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID), the record's card number (CARD-NUM) must equal the filter value (CC-CARD-NUM-N), otherwise the record is excluded; if both filters are active, both conditions must be satisfied for the record to be included; records passing all active filters are marked as 'do not exclude' and included in the display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Account and Card Number Filters to Each Record During Backward Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each record read during backward navigation is evaluated against the active account ID and card number filters. Records that do not match the active filter criteria are excluded from the display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been read during backward navigation and filter evaluation has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The record does not match one or more active filter criteria (account ID filter or card number filter)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The record is excluded from the display (WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD is set), the screen row counter is not decremented, no data is placed in any screen row for this record, and the system immediately reads the next previous record from the card file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Filtered-Out Records and Continue Reading
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record does not pass the active filter criteria during backward navigation, it is silently skipped and the system continues reading the next previous record without decrementing the row counter.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been read and has passed all active filter criteria during backward navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The record is accepted for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system places the card number (CARD-NUM) into WS-ROW-CARD-NUM at the current screen counter position, the account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) into WS-ROW-ACCTNO at the current screen counter position, and the card active status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) into WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS at the current screen counter position

all_rules.Rule_Name: Place Filtered Record Data into Next Available Screen Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record passes all active filters during backward navigation, its data is placed into the next available screen row (filling from bottom to top), populating the card number, account number, and active status fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully placed into a screen row during backward navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row placement is complete
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) is decremented by 1 to point to the next row upward in the screen array

all_rules.Rule_Name: Move Up One Row in Screen Array After Placing Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After placing a record into a screen row during backward navigation, the system decrements the row counter to move to the next row upward, maintaining the bottom-to-top fill order.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been placed into a screen row and the row counter has been decremented during backward navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) reaches zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the read loop exit flag (READ-LOOP-EXIT) to terminate the backward read loop, updates the first card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-ACCT-ID) with the current record's account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID), and updates the first card number bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM) with the current record's card number (CARD-NUM)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect All 7 Screen Rows Filled and Update First Card Bookmark
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen row counter reaches zero after decrementing, all 7 rows have been filled. The system records the last record placed (which is in row 1, the topmost row) as the new first card key bookmark for future navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backward read loop is active and fewer than 7 screen rows have been filled
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The READPREV operation returns an end-of-file response indicating the beginning of the card file has been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the read loop exit flag to terminate the backward read loop and proceeds to close the browse session; the screen will display only the records that were successfully retrieved (fewer than 7 rows may be populated)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle End of File During Backward Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the backward read reaches the beginning of the card file before all 7 rows are filled, the system recognizes there are no more previous records and terminates the read loop.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backward read loop has terminated for any reason (all rows filled, end of file, or read error)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backward read procedure concludes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system closes the card file browse session (ENDBR on LIT-CARD-FILE) to properly end the file browsing operation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Card File Browse Session After Backward Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the backward read loop completes (whether all rows are filled, end of file is reached, or an error occurs), the system closes the card file browse session to release the file resource.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backward read has completed and the system is preparing to display the updated card list screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen initialization step (1100-SCREEN-INIT) is performed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates the screen output area (CCRDLIAO) with: the two application title lines (CCDA-TITLE01, CCDA-TITLE02), the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) in the transaction name field, the program name (LIT-THISPGM) in the program name field, the current date formatted as MM/DD/YY in the date field, the current time formatted as HH:MM:SS in the time field, and the current page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) in the page number field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Screen Header with Current Date, Time, Titles, and Page Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before sending the updated screen to the user, the system initializes the screen header area with the application titles, current date, current time, transaction ID, program name, and current page number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen header has been initialized and card records have been retrieved via backward read
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen array population step (1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT) is performed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For each of the 7 screen rows (1 through 7): if the row's data area (WS-EACH-CARD) is not empty (not LOW-VALUES), the system copies the selection field value (WS-EDIT-SELECT) to the corresponding screen selection output field (CRDSELnO), the account number (WS-ROW-ACCTNO) to the account number output field (ACCTNOnO), the card number (WS-ROW-CARD-NUM) to the card number output field (CRDNUMnO), and the card active status (WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS) to the card status output field (CRDSTSnO); rows with empty data are left blank on screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Screen Rows with Retrieved Card Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system populates each of the 7 screen display rows with the card data retrieved during the backward read, including the selection field value, account number, card number, and card active status for each row that contains data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen rows have been populated with card data and the system is setting display attributes (1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The display attributes are configured for each of the 7 row selection fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For each row 1 through 7: if the row data is empty (WS-EACH-CARD equals LOW-VALUES) OR the protect-select-rows flag is set (FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES), the selection field attribute is set to protected (DFHBMPRF for row 1, DFHBMPRO for rows 2-7); otherwise if the row has a selection error flag set to '1' (WS-ROW-CRDSELECT-ERROR), the selection field color is set to red (DFHRED) and for row 1 if the selection value is space or LOW-VALUES an asterisk '*' is placed in the field; for all non-empty, non-protected rows the selection field attribute is set to unprotected editable (DFHBMFSE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Row Display Attributes - Protect Empty Rows and Highlight Errors in Red
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system sets the display attributes for each of the 7 selection fields: empty rows and rows in error-protected state have their selection fields set to protected (non-enterable), while rows with errors are highlighted in red and rows with valid data are set to editable.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The row display attributes have been set and the system is configuring filter field display (1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen filter fields and cursor position are configured
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the session is a fresh entry from the menu program, filter fields are left as-is; otherwise: for the account ID filter field - if the account filter is valid or invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK), display CC-ACCT-ID value with editable attribute; if account ID is zero display LOW-VALUES; otherwise display CDEMO-ACCT-ID with editable attribute; for the card number filter field - if the card filter is valid or invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), display CC-CARD-NUM value with editable attribute; if card number is zero display LOW-VALUES; otherwise display CDEMO-CARD-NUM with editable attribute; if the account filter is invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK), set the account field color to red and set cursor length to -1; if the card filter is invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), set the card field color to red and set cursor length to -1; if input is valid (INPUT-OK), set cursor length to -1 on the account ID field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Search Filter Values and Position Cursor on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system displays the current account ID and card number filter values in their respective screen fields, applies appropriate attributes, and positions the cursor to highlight any invalid filter fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen filter fields have been configured and the system is setting the screen message (1400-SETUP-MESSAGE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The message content is determined based on current state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system evaluates conditions in priority order: if account or card filter is invalid, no message change is made (CONTINUE); else if PF7 was pressed and currently on the first page, set error message to 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY'; else if PF8 was pressed and no next page exists and the last page was already shown, set error message to 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY'; else if PF8 was pressed and no next page exists (last page not yet shown), set the informational message to the record action instructions and mark the last page as shown; else if no info message is set or a next page exists, set the informational message to the record action instructions; otherwise set no-info-message flag; the error message (WS-ERROR-MSG) is always moved to the screen error message field (ERRMSGO); if an informational message is active and no-records-found is not set, the informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) is displayed in the info message field (INFOMSGO) with neutral color (DFHNEUTR)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Informational Message for Available Record Actions
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system determines and sets the appropriate informational or error message to display on the screen based on the current pagination state and navigation action performed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen has been fully prepared with header, card data rows, attributes, filter values, and messages
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen send step (1500-SEND-SCREEN) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sends the screen map (LIT-THISMAP) from the mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET) using the output data area (CCRDLIAO) to the user's terminal with cursor positioning enabled, the previous screen content erased (ERASE), and the keyboard released (FREEKB) for the next user interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Send Updated Card List Screen to User Terminal
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system sends the fully prepared card list screen to the user's terminal, erasing the previous screen content and releasing the keyboard for the next user input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The updated card list screen has been sent to the user after backward navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The session state is saved in the COMMON-RETURN procedure
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) in CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, the program name (LIT-THISPGM) in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, the map set name (LIT-THISMAPSET) in CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET, and the map name (LIT-THISMAP) in CDEMO-LAST-MAP; the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is copied to WS-COMMAREA and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is appended to WS-COMMAREA; the system then returns to CICS with the transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) and the combined communication area (WS-COMMAREA) so that the first card key bookmark, last card key bookmark, page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM), and pagination indicators (CA-FIRST-PAGE, CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) are preserved for the next user interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Session State After Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After displaying the previous page, the system saves the current session state including card key bookmarks, page number, and pagination indicators to the communication area so navigation can continue correctly on the next user interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and has pressed a key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The key pressed is not one of the recognized navigation keys (Enter, PF3, PF7, or PF8)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system treats the key press as an Enter key press and proceeds with Enter key processing logic

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Enter Key Press for Card Row Action
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system identifies whether the user pressed the Enter key to trigger a card row action. Any unrecognized key press is treated as an Enter key press to ensure the screen processes the user's input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and has pressed the Enter key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user has entered action code 'S' (View) in one of the seven card row selection fields and the row selection validation has identified the selected row index (I-SELECTED)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system recognizes a View action request on the selected card row and proceeds to verify the program context before transferring to the Card Detail screen; if no 'S' action code is found, the system continues with other processing logic

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate View Action Code Selected on Card Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system checks whether the user has entered the View action code 'S' in exactly one card row's selection field before pressing Enter. This determines whether the user intends to view the details of a specific card.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed Enter with action code 'S' selected on a card row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The originating program recorded in the communication area is equal to the Card List program identifier (LIT-THISPGM / COCRDSLI)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system confirms a valid program context and proceeds to retrieve the selected card's details for transfer; if the originating program is not the Card List program, the system skips the Card Detail transfer and continues with other processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Program Context for Card Detail Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system verifies that the current interaction originated from the Card List program itself (COCRDSLI), ensuring the user is in a valid session context before allowing navigation to the Card Detail screen. This prevents unauthorized or out-of-context transfers.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed Enter with action code 'S' on a card row and the program context has been validated as the Card List program
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system identifies the selected row index (I-SELECTED) from the card list display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Account ID (WS-ROW-ACCTNO at position I-SELECTED) and the Card Number (WS-ROW-CARD-NUM at position I-SELECTED) from the displayed card list rows and stores them as the target Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and target Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) in the communication area

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Selected Card Row Account and Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system retrieves the Account ID and Card Number from the specific card row the user selected with action code 'S'. These values are sourced from the currently displayed card list rows and will be passed to the Card Detail program.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The selected card row's Account ID and Card Number have been retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to transfer control for a View action
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the next program to the Card Detail program (LIT-CARDDTLPGM / COCRDSLC), sets the next mapset to the Card Detail mapset (LIT-CARDDTLMAPSET), and sets the next map to the Card Detail map (LIT-CARDDTLMAP)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Card Detail Program as Navigation Destination
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system designates the Card Detail program (COCRDSLC) as the next program to be invoked, along with its associated map and mapset, establishing the complete navigation destination for the card view action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Detail program (COCRDSLC) has been set as the navigation destination and the selected card's Account ID and Card Number are ready
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the transfer to the Card Detail program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system records the current transaction ID as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), records the Card List program as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), sets the user type to standard user (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER), sets the program state to entering (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER), records the current mapset (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET) and map (CDEMO-LAST-MAP), places the selected Account ID into the communication area field CDEMO-ACCT-ID, places the selected Card Number into the communication area field CDEMO-CARD-NUM, and transfers control to the Card Detail program (COCRDSLC) passing the fully populated communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Pass Selected Card Details in Communication Area and Transfer to Card Detail Program
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system populates the communication area with the selected card's Account ID and Card Number, records the originating program context, and transfers control to the Card Detail program (COCRDSLC) so the detail screen can display the correct card information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed the Enter key on the Card List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Either the action code entered is not 'S' (View) on any card row, or the originating program in the communication area is not the Card List program (COCRDSLI)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does not transfer to the Card Detail program and instead continues evaluating the remaining processing conditions in the main action routing logic (such as Update action 'U', error conditions, or default forward read)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Bypass Card Detail Transfer for Non-View Actions
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Enter key is pressed but the action code is not 'S' (View), or the program context is not the Card List program, the system bypasses the Card Detail transfer and continues evaluating other applicable processing paths such as Update, error handling, or default display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Card List screen and has entered an action code in one of the seven card rows
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the Enter key and the system evaluates the submitted action
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds with the Card Update transfer ONLY IF: (1) the action code entered on the selected row is 'U' (Update), AND (2) the request is originating from the Card List program (COCRDSLI) itself. If the action code is not 'U', or if the request did not originate from the Card List program, the update transfer is bypassed and processing continues with other applicable logic.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Update Action Code and Request Origin Before Card Update Transfer
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses Enter on the Card List screen, the system must verify that the selected row has an update action code ('U') AND that the request is originating from the Card List program itself before proceeding with the card update transfer. If either condition fails, the update transfer is bypassed and normal processing continues.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered action code 'U' on one of the seven displayed card rows and pressed Enter, and the request has been confirmed as originating from the Card List program
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system identifies the selected row index (I-SELECTED) corresponding to the row where 'U' was entered
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Account ID (WS-ROW-ACCTNO of the selected row) and the Card Number (WS-ROW-CARD-NUM of the selected row) from the selected card row and stores them as the target Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and target Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) in the communication area for passing to the Card Update program.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Selected Card Account ID and Card Number for Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once the update action is confirmed valid, the system retrieves the Account ID and Card Number from the specific card row that the user selected with the 'U' action code, to be passed to the Card Update program.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has confirmed the update action code 'U' is valid and the selected card's Account ID and Card Number have been retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the communication area for the transfer to the Card Update program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the following fields in the communication area: (1) Originating Transaction ID is set to the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID), (2) Originating Program is set to the Card List program name (LIT-THISPGM / COCRDSLI), (3) User Type is set to regular User, (4) Program State is set to Enter (first-time entry), (5) Last Mapset is set to the Card List mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET), (6) Last Map is set to the Card List map (LIT-THISMAP), (7) Next Program is set to the Card Update program name (LIT-CARDUPDPGM / COCRDUPC), (8) Next Mapset is set to the Card Update mapset (LIT-CARDUPDMAPSET), (9) Next Map is set to the Card Update map (LIT-CARDUPDMAP).

all_rules.Rule_Name: Prepare Communication Area Context for Card Update Program Transfer
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before transferring control to the Card Update program, the system must populate the communication area with the current program context, including the originating transaction ID, originating program name, user type, program entry state, last map and mapset used, and the target Card Update program details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The communication area has been fully populated with the selected card's Account ID, Card Number, current program context, and the Card Update program as the target next program
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the program transfer
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Control is transferred to the Card Update program (COCRDUPC) with the complete communication area passed, containing the selected Account ID and Card Number, so that the Card Update screen is displayed to the user pre-loaded with the correct card record for updating. The Card List program terminates its current execution cycle upon transfer.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transfer Control to Card Update Program with Selected Card Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the communication area is fully prepared with the selected card's Account ID, Card Number, and program context, the system transfers control directly to the Card Update program (COCRDUPC), passing the complete communication area so the Card Update screen is displayed to the user with the correct card pre-loaded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is in the default/other condition path and needs to display or refresh the credit card list
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to read forward through the credit card file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The first card key stored in the session (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM) is set as the starting record identifier (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) for the forward browse operation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Starting Position for Forward Browse Using First Card Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the default forward read is triggered (all other conditions), the system uses the stored first card key as the starting position for browsing the credit card file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to perform a forward read to populate the credit card list screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The forward read process (9000-READ-FORWARD) is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All 7 card data rows on the screen are reset to empty (LOW-VALUES), ensuring no previously displayed card data remains visible

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Screen Rows Before Populating New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before reading and populating card records onto the screen, all 7 display rows must be cleared to ensure no stale data from a previous page is shown to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen rows have been cleared and the starting card key (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) has been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a browse on the Credit Card file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A forward browse is opened on the Credit Card file starting at the first record whose key is greater than or equal to the specified starting card key, and the screen row counter is initialized to zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Forward Browse on Credit Card File from Starting Position
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system opens a forward browse on the Credit Card file starting at or after the specified card key position, using a greater-than-or-equal (GTEQ) positioning strategy.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A forward browse is open on the Credit Card file and the screen is not yet full (fewer than 7 records populated)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the next record in the forward browse loop
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next credit card record is retrieved from the Credit Card file into the card record buffer; if the read is successful (normal or duplicate record), processing continues to filter evaluation; if end of file is reached, the end-of-file handling path is taken

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Next Credit Card Record During Forward Browse
all_rules.Rule_Description: During the forward browse loop, the system sequentially reads the next available credit card record from the Credit Card file to evaluate it for display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A credit card record has been successfully read from the file and an Account ID filter is active (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The filter check (9500-FILTER-RECORDS) is performed on the record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the record's Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) matches the filter Account ID (CC-ACCT-ID), the record is retained for further evaluation; if the Account ID does not match, the record is excluded and the system moves on to read the next record without adding it to the display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Account ID Filter to Credit Card Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Account ID filter has been provided by the user, each retrieved credit card record is checked to determine whether its account ID matches the filter value. Records that do not match are excluded from display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A credit card record has passed the Account ID filter check (or no Account ID filter is active) and a Card Number filter is active (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card number filter check (9500-FILTER-RECORDS) is performed on the record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the record's Card Number (CARD-NUM) matches the filter Card Number (CC-CARD-NUM-N), the record is retained for display; if the Card Number does not match, the record is excluded and the system moves on to read the next record without adding it to the display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Card Number Filter to Credit Card Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Card Number filter has been provided by the user, each retrieved credit card record is checked to determine whether its card number matches the filter value. Records that do not match are excluded from display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A credit card record has passed all active filter checks and is eligible for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The record is added to the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen row counter is incremented by 1, and the record's Card Number (CARD-NUM), Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID), and Card Active Status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) are stored in the corresponding screen row fields (WS-ROW-CARD-NUM, WS-ROW-ACCTNO, WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS) at the position indicated by the screen row counter

all_rules.Rule_Name: Add Matching Credit Card Record to Screen Display Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a credit card record passes all active filters, its key data fields are stored in the next available screen display row for presentation to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A credit card record has just been added to the screen and the screen row counter equals 1 (this is the first record on the page)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first-record check is performed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The record's Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is saved as the first card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-ACCT-ID), the record's Card Number (CARD-NUM) is saved as the first card number bookmark (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM), and if the current page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is zero, it is incremented by 1 to set it to page 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save First Card Key and Set Page Number on First Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the first qualifying record is added to the screen (screen row counter becomes 1), the system saves its account ID and card number as the first-card bookmark for backward (page-up) navigation, and initializes the page number to 1 if it has not been set yet.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A credit card record has been added to the screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether the screen is full
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) equals the maximum screen lines (WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES, which is 7), the screen is considered full and the system proceeds to save the last card key and check for more records; if the counter is less than 7, the system continues reading the next record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Screen Full Condition After 7 Records Are Populated
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each record is added to the screen, the system checks whether the maximum number of displayable records (7) has been reached to determine whether to stop reading and check for additional pages.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen has been filled with the maximum number of records (7) and the screen full condition has been detected
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The last card key is saved
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The last displayed record's Account ID (CARD-ACCT-ID) is saved as the last card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID) and the last displayed record's Card Number (CARD-NUM) is saved as the last card number bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Last Card Key When Screen Is Full
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen has been filled with 7 records, the system saves the account ID and card number of the last displayed record as a bookmark to support forward (page-down) navigation to the next page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen has been filled with 7 records and the last card key bookmark has been saved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a peek-ahead read of one additional record from the Credit Card file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the additional record is read successfully (normal or duplicate), the next page is marked as available (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS) and the last card key bookmarks (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM) are updated to this next record's values; if end of file is reached, no next page is marked (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS) and the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set (if no prior error message exists)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Peek Ahead to Determine If a Next Page of Records Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: After filling the screen with 7 records, the system reads one additional record beyond the last displayed record to determine whether more records exist, enabling the system to correctly indicate whether a next page is available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is full with 7 records and a peek-ahead read has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The peek-ahead read returns a record successfully (normal or duplicate response)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next page indicator is set to available (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS is TRUE), and the last card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID) and last card number bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM) are updated to the peek-ahead record's Account ID and Card Number respectively

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Next Page as Available When More Records Exist Beyond Current Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the peek-ahead read confirms that at least one more record exists beyond the current page, the system marks the next page as available and updates the last card key bookmark to the position of that next record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is full with 7 records and a peek-ahead read has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The peek-ahead read reaches end of file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next page indicator is set to not available (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is TRUE), and the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set if no prior error message has been set (WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF is TRUE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark No More Pages When End of File Reached After Full Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the peek-ahead read after filling the screen reaches end of file, the system marks that no further pages exist, indicating to the user that the current page is the last page of results.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is reading records in the forward browse loop and the screen has fewer than 7 records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: End of file is reached on the Credit Card file during the READNEXT operation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The read loop is terminated, the next page indicator is set to not available (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is TRUE), the last card account ID bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID) and last card number bookmark (WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM) are saved from the last record encountered, and the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' is set if no prior error message exists

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle End of File During Forward Read Before Screen Is Full
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the end of the Credit Card file is reached during the forward read loop before the screen is filled, the system marks that no next page exists and records the last card key bookmarks from the final record read.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: End of file has been reached during the forward read and the system is on page 1 (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM equals 1)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether any records were found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the screen row counter (WS-SCRN-COUNTER) equals zero (no records were added to the screen), the No Records Found indicator (WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND) is set to TRUE, signaling that no credit cards match the current search criteria

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set No Records Found Message When First Page Returns Zero Matching Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the system is displaying the first page of results and end of file is reached with zero records having been added to the screen, the system sets a 'No Records Found' indicator to inform the user that no credit cards match the current search criteria.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The forward read loop has completed, either because the screen is full (7 records) or end of file has been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system finalizes the read operation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The browse session on the Credit Card file is closed (ENDBR is executed), releasing the file browse resources

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Credit Card File Browse After Reading Is Complete
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all required records have been read (either the screen is full or end of file has been reached), the system closes the browse session on the Credit Card file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The forward read is complete and the screen data rows have been populated with matching credit card records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the credit card list screen to the user (1000-SEND-MAP)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen is built with: (1) screen header including title, transaction ID, program name, current date, current time, and current page number; (2) up to 7 card rows each showing Account Number, Card Number, and Card Active Status; (3) selection fields set as editable for populated rows and protected for empty rows; (4) filter field values restored on screen; (5) appropriate messages such as 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' or informational action guidance; and the completed screen is sent to the user with the keyboard unlocked

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Credit Card List Screen with Populated Records and Messages
all_rules.Rule_Description: After reading and filtering credit card records, the system builds and sends the credit card list screen to the user, showing all found card records along with appropriate navigation messages and field attributes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card List screen is about to be sent to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen header initialization process begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All fields in the screen output area (CCRDLIAO) are reset to empty/low values, ensuring no stale data from any prior screen display remains visible

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Screen Output Area Before Populating Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating any screen header fields, the entire screen output area must be cleared to ensure no residual data from previous displays appears on the new screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen output area has been cleared and header initialization is in progress
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Application titles are being set on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Title Line 1 on the screen header is populated with the value from the application-defined constant CCDA-TITLE01, and Title Line 2 is populated with the value from the application-defined constant CCDA-TITLE02

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Application Title Lines on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display two standard application title lines sourced from the application's centrally defined title constants, ensuring consistent branding across the Card Demo application.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen header is being initialized for the Card List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction identifier field is being populated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction name field (TRNNAMEO) on the screen header is populated with the current transaction ID defined by the application literal LIT-THISTRANID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Transaction Identifier on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must always display the transaction identifier associated with the current Card List transaction, allowing users to identify which transaction they are working within.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen header is being initialized for the Card List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program name field is being populated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program name field (PGMNAMEO) on the screen header is populated with the current program name defined by the application literal LIT-THISPGM

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Program Name on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must always display the name of the currently executing program, providing users and support staff with clear identification of which program is active.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen header is being initialized and the current date is needed for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The date retrieval and formatting process executes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the current date using the system date function into WS-CURDATE-DATA; the month component (WS-CURDATE-MONTH) is extracted into WS-CURDATE-MM; the day component (WS-CURDATE-DAY) is extracted into WS-CURDATE-DD; the last two digits of the year (WS-CURDATE-YEAR positions 3 through 4) are extracted into WS-CURDATE-YY; the assembled MM/DD/YY formatted date (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY) is placed into the date display field (CURDATEO) on the screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve and Format Current System Date for Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display today's date in MM/DD/YY format. The system retrieves the current date, extracts the month, day, and last two digits of the year, assembles them into the standard display format, and places the result in the date field on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current system date-time has already been retrieved into WS-CURDATE-DATA during the same screen initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The time formatting and display process executes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The hours component (WS-CURTIME-HOURS) is extracted into WS-CURTIME-HH; the minutes component (WS-CURTIME-MINUTE) is extracted into WS-CURTIME-MM; the seconds component (WS-CURTIME-SECOND) is extracted into WS-CURTIME-SS; the assembled HH:MM:SS formatted time (WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS) is placed into the time display field (CURTIMEO) on the screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve and Format Current System Time for Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display the current time in HH:MM:SS format. The system extracts hours, minutes, and seconds from the previously retrieved system date-time value, assembles them into the standard time display format, and places the result in the time field on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen header is being initialized and a page number is maintained in the session state
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The page number field is being populated on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current page number stored in WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is placed into the page number display field (PAGENOO) on the screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Page Number on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display the current page number so users can track their position within the paginated card list. The page number reflects which page of results is currently being viewed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen header initialization is completing its setup sequence
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The informational message area is being initialized
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE flag is set to TRUE indicating no informational message is active by default; the content of WS-INFO-MSG is moved into the informational message display field (INFOMSGO) on the screen; the color attribute of the informational message field (INFOMSGC) is set to dark (DFHBMDAR), rendering it non-highlighted in its default state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Informational Message Area on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: During screen header initialization, the informational message area must be set to its default state: the no-information-message indicator is set, the current informational message content is placed in the message field, and the message color attribute is set to dark (non-highlighted), ensuring the message area starts in a neutral display state before any conditional message logic applies.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card list screen is being prepared for display and Row 1 of the card data array is empty (contains no card record data)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether Row 1 has data available to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Row 1 is skipped entirely with no data populated on the screen for that row, and the system proceeds to evaluate Row 2

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Empty Card Row 1 During Screen Population
all_rules.Rule_Description: When populating the card list screen, Row 1 is only filled with card data if it contains a valid record. If Row 1 has no data, it is silently skipped and the system moves on to evaluate Row 2.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card list screen is being prepared for display and Row 1 of the card data array contains a valid credit card record (data is not empty)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that Row 1 has data available
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates all four fields for Row 1 on the screen: (1) the Selection Indicator field is set from the row's edit-select value, (2) the Account Number field is set from the row's account number value, (3) the Card Number field is set from the row's card number value, and (4) the Card Active Status field is set from the row's card status value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Card Data for Row 1
all_rules.Rule_Description: When Row 1 of the card data array contains a valid credit card record, all four data fields for that row are populated on the screen: the selection indicator (for View/Update action), the account number, the card number, and the card active status.
